places.hook: A steep medieval lane drops between City buildings toward St Magnus and the Thames.
places.hookIt: Un ripido vicolo medievale scende tra gli edifici della City verso St Magnus e il Tamigi.

places.name: Lower Marsh
places.description: Lower Marsh is a historic trading street behind Waterloo station, with a market formally established in the nineteenth century. Independent cafés, food stalls, specialist shops and surviving shopfronts reflect its long role serving travellers, workers and the surrounding Lambeth community.
places.descriptionIt: Lower Marsh è una storica strada commerciale dietro Waterloo, con mercato formalizzato nell’Ottocento. Caffè indipendenti, bancarelle, negozi specializzati e vetrine superstiti riflettono il ruolo svolto per viaggiatori, lavoratori e comunità di Lambeth.
places.accessNotes: Public street or outdoor public realm. Access is generally unrestricted, but individual shops, courtyards and buildings keep their own hours and may be private.

places.hook: Market stalls and independent shopfronts preserve a working high street behind Waterloo station.
places.hookIt: Bancarelle e vetrine indipendenti conservano una strada commerciale viva dietro la stazione di Waterloo.

places.name: Mayfair core
places.description: Mayfair’s historic core lies around Grosvenor Square, Mount Street, Shepherd Market and the surviving mews between them. Aristocratic estate planning, Georgian houses, embassies, luxury retail and hidden gardens reveal a district more architecturally varied than its expensive reputation suggests.
places.descriptionIt: Il nucleo storico di Mayfair si estende tra Grosvenor Square, Mount Street, Shepherd Market e i mews superstiti. Pianificazione aristocratica, case georgiane, ambasciate, lusso e giardini nascosti mostrano un quartiere più vario della sola reputazione costosa.

places.hook: Georgian squares, hidden mews and estate gardens reveal the urban structure beneath Mayfair’s luxury image.
places.hookIt: Piazze georgiane, mews nascosti e giardini di proprietà rivelano la struttura urbana dietro l’immagine lussuosa di Mayfair.

places.name: Mews Arch
places.description: The mews arch near Ennismore Gardens marks the threshold between grand Knightsbridge streets and their former service lanes. Its masonry opening frames smaller coach houses behind, making the hierarchy of townhouse, stable yard and concealed working access immediately legible.
places.descriptionIt: L’arco del mews vicino Ennismore Gardens segna il passaggio tra le grandi strade di Knightsbridge e gli antichi vicoli di servizio. L’apertura in muratura incornicia piccole rimesse e rende leggibile la gerarchia tra casa, scuderia e accesso operativo.

places.hook: A masonry arch neatly frames the change from grand Knightsbridge terraces to their former stable lane.
places.hookIt: Un arco in muratura incornicia il passaggio dalle grandi terrazze di Knightsbridge all’antico vicolo delle scuderie.

places.name: Millennium Bridge
places.description: The Millennium Bridge opened in 2000 as London’s first new pedestrian Thames crossing for more than a century. Foster and Partners’ low-slung steel design preserves a direct visual axis between St Paul’s Cathedral and Tate Modern, with river traffic visible through its slender structure.
places.descriptionIt: Il Millennium Bridge aprì nel 2000 come primo nuovo ponte pedonale londinese sul Tamigi dopo oltre un secolo. Il basso disegno in acciaio di Foster and Partners mantiene l’asse visivo tra St Paul’s e Tate Modern, lasciando visibile il traffico fluviale.

places.hook: A low steel crossing creates London’s clearest pedestrian axis between St Paul’s and Tate Modern.
places.hookIt: Un basso ponte d’acciaio crea il più chiaro asse pedonale di Londra tra St Paul’s e Tate Modern.

places.name: Motcomb Street
places.description: Motcomb Street is a curved Belgravia shopping street linking Lowndes Square with Knightsbridge. Nineteenth-century façades, independent food shops and the landmark Pantechnicon building create a compact neighbourhood centre within the larger Grosvenor estate.
places.descriptionIt: Motcomb Street è una strada commerciale curva di Belgravia tra Lowndes Square e Knightsbridge. Facciate ottocentesche, negozi alimentari indipendenti e il Pantechnicon formano un compatto centro di quartiere nel grande Grosvenor Estate.

places.hook: Independent food shops and the Pantechnicon animate a curved Belgravia street behind Knightsbridge.
places.hookIt: Negozi alimentari indipendenti e il Pantechnicon animano una strada curva di Belgravia dietro Knightsbridge.

places.name: Mount Street Gardens
places.description: Mount Street Gardens opened as a public garden in 1889 on the former burial ground of St George’s Hanover Square. Plane trees, exotic planting, ornate benches and the Gothic Church of the Immaculate Conception create a secluded green room behind Mayfair’s commercial streets.
places.descriptionIt: Mount Street Gardens aprì come giardino pubblico nel 1889 sull’antico cimitero di St George’s Hanover Square. Platani, piante esotiche, panchine decorate e la chiesa gotica dell’Immacolata creano una stanza verde appartata dietro le vie commerciali di Mayfair.

places.hook: A former burial ground has become a richly planted green room behind Mayfair’s Mount Street.
places.hookIt: Un antico cimitero è diventato una ricca stanza verde dietro Mount Street a Mayfair.

places.name: New Row
places.description: New Row is a narrow Covent Garden shopping street running toward St Martin’s Lane. Small Georgian and Victorian frontages contain specialist food shops, pubs and independent retailers, preserving a fine-grained commercial route just outside the market piazza.
places.descriptionIt: New Row è una stretta strada commerciale di Covent Garden verso St Martin’s Lane. Piccoli fronti georgiani e vittoriani ospitano alimentari specializzati, pub e negozi indipendenti, conservando una trama minuta appena fuori dalla piazza del mercato.

places.hookIt: Piccole vetrine storiche fanno di New Row un collegamento commerciale minuto oltre la piazza di Covent Garden.

places.name: Newman Passage
places.description: Newman Passage is a narrow Fitzrovia alley associated with the opening murder scene of Michael Powell’s film ‘Peeping Tom’. Brick walls, service entrances and its abrupt turn preserve the backstage character of a district once dense with workshops and studios.
places.descriptionIt: Newman Passage è uno stretto vicolo di Fitzrovia legato alla scena iniziale del delitto nel film “Peeping Tom” di Michael Powell. Muri in mattoni, ingressi di servizio e la svolta improvvisa conservano il carattere dietro le quinte di un quartiere di laboratori e studi.

places.hook: A cramped Fitzrovia passage carries an unsettling place in British cinema through ‘Peeping Tom’.
places.hookIt: Uno stretto passaggio di Fitzrovia occupa un luogo inquietante nel cinema britannico grazie a “Peeping Tom”.

places.name: Odhams Walk
places.description: Odhams Walk is a 1970s housing estate built on the former Odhams Press site in Covent Garden. Brick terraces, bridges, planted decks and traffic-free courtyards form a dense but sociable piece of low-rise architecture, sharply different from the surrounding West End streets.
places.descriptionIt: Odhams Walk è un complesso residenziale degli anni Settanta costruito sul sito dell’ex Odhams Press a Covent Garden. Terrazze in mattoni, ponti, terrazze verdi e cortili senza auto formano un’architettura densa ma comunitaria, diversa dal West End circostante.

places.hook: Brick walkways and planted decks turn a former printing site into a distinctive traffic-free housing landscape.
places.hookIt: Passerelle in mattoni e terrazze verdi trasformano un’antica tipografia in un caratteristico paesaggio residenziale senza auto.

places.name: Old Bond Street
places.description: Old Bond Street forms the southern, older section of Bond Street and has concentrated luxury retail, art dealers and auction houses for centuries. Historic façades and arcades sit among global brands, while the ‘Allies’ bench sculpture captures Churchill and Roosevelt in conversation.
places.descriptionIt: Old Bond Street forma la parte meridionale e più antica di Bond Street, sede da secoli di lusso, mercanti d’arte e case d’asta. Facciate storiche e gallerie convivono con marchi globali, mentre la panchina “Allies” ritrae Churchill e Roosevelt.

places.hook: Art dealers, historic arcades and the seated ‘Allies’ preserve layers beneath Bond Street’s luxury frontage.
places.hookIt: Mercanti d’arte, gallerie storiche e gli “Allies” seduti conservano strati di storia sotto il lusso di Bond Street.

places.name: Original site of the Globe Theatre
places.description: The foundations of Shakespeare’s original Globe survive beneath Anchor Terrace on Park Street, marked at street level rather than reconstructed. Built in 1599 by the Lord Chamberlain’s Men, the playhouse staged works including ‘Hamlet’ and ‘King Lear’ before burning in 1613.
places.descriptionIt: Le fondazioni del Globe originale di Shakespeare sopravvivono sotto Anchor Terrace in Park Street, segnalate in superficie ma non ricostruite. Costruito nel 1599 dai Lord Chamberlain’s Men, ospitò opere come “Hamlet” e “King Lear” prima di bruciare nel 1613.

places.hook: A simple street marker identifies where Shakespeare’s company built the original Globe in 1599.
places.hookIt: Un semplice segno stradale indica dove la compagnia di Shakespeare costruì il Globe originale nel 1599.

places.name: Osten Mews
places.description: Osten Mews is a narrow Kensington stable lane behind the terraces near Gloucester Road. Brick coach houses, painted garage doors and surviving carriage openings reveal the service architecture once required by the district’s larger Victorian homes.
places.descriptionIt: Osten Mews è uno stretto vicolo di scuderie a Kensington dietro le terrazze vicino Gloucester Road. Rimesse in mattoni, porte dipinte e aperture carrabili superstiti rivelano l’architettura di servizio delle grandi case vittoriane.

places.accessNotesIt: Strada o spazio pubblico all’aperto. L’accesso è generalmente libero, ma negozi, cortili ed edifici hanno orari propri e possono essere privati.
places.hook: Brick coach houses preserve the equestrian service lane behind Gloucester Road’s formal terraces.
places.hookIt: Rimesse in mattoni conservano il vicolo di servizio equestre dietro le terrazze formali di Gloucester Road.

places.name: Oxford Circus
places.description: Oxford Circus is the 1810s intersection of John Nash’s Regent Street with Oxford Street, later rebuilt with four matching quadrant buildings. The diagonal pedestrian crossing reveals the geometry of one of Europe’s busiest retail junctions and the sweep of Regent Street’s façades.
places.descriptionIt: Oxford Circus è l’incrocio ottocentesco tra Regent Street di John Nash e Oxford Street, poi ricostruito con quattro edifici coordinati agli angoli. L’attraversamento diagonale rende leggibile la geometria di uno dei nodi commerciali più affollati d’Europa.
places.accessNotes: Public street or outdoor public realm. Access is generally unrestricted, but individual shops, courtyards and buildings keep their own hours and may be private.

places.hook: Four matching quadrants and a diagonal crossing expose the geometry of London’s busiest retail junction.
places.hookIt: Quattro angoli coordinati e un attraversamento diagonale mostrano la geometria del più affollato incrocio commerciale londinese.

places.name: Park Square Mews
places.description: Park Square Mews forms the service lane behind John Nash’s grand Park Square terraces beside Regent’s Park. Coach houses, cobbles and restrained stucco details preserve the functional counterpart to the formal Regency composition facing the private garden.
places.descriptionIt: Park Square Mews è il vicolo di servizio dietro le grandi terrazze di Park Square progettate da John Nash accanto a Regent’s Park. Rimesse, selciato e sobri dettagli in stucco conservano il lato funzionale della composizione Regency affacciata sul giardino.

places.hook: Former coach houses reveal the working back of John Nash’s formal Park Square terraces.
places.hookIt: Le antiche rimesse mostrano il retro operativo delle terrazze formali di Park Square progettate da John Nash.

places.name: Parkland Walk
places.description: Parkland Walk follows the former Great Northern Railway branch between Finsbury Park and Highgate, with a second section toward Alexandra Palace. Platforms, bridges and tunnels have become a wooded nature reserve, including the eerie Spriggan sculpture emerging from a former railway arch.
places.descriptionIt: Parkland Walk segue l’antica linea della Great Northern Railway tra Finsbury Park e Highgate, con una seconda sezione verso Alexandra Palace. Banchine, ponti e tunnel sono diventati riserva naturale boscosa, con la figura dello Spriggan che emerge da un arco ferroviario.

places.hook: Disused platforms, railway arches and the Spriggan sculpture hide along London’s longest linear nature reserve.
places.hookIt: Banchine dismesse, archi ferroviari e la scultura dello Spriggan si nascondono nella più lunga riserva naturale lineare di Londra.

places.name: Passing Alley
places.description: Passing Alley is linked to the former Middlesex House of Detention and the public route beside Clerkenwell Close. Its name is traditionally associated with the passage of prisoners toward execution, adding a grim layer to an otherwise modest lane near the old prison site.
places.descriptionIt: Passing Alley è legato all’antica Middlesex House of Detention e al percorso pubblico vicino Clerkenwell Close. Il nome è tradizionalmente associato al passaggio dei prigionieri verso l’esecuzione, aggiungendo uno strato cupo a un modesto vicolo vicino all’ex carcere.

places.hook: A modest Clerkenwell alley carries the memory of prisoners passing from the old House of Detention.
places.hookIt: Un modesto vicolo di Clerkenwell conserva la memoria dei prigionieri in uscita dall’antica House of Detention.

places.name: Pavillion rd
places.description: Pavilion Road was originally a service street for the grand houses of Sloane Street and Cadogan Square. Restored brick shopfronts now house artisan food specialists and independent retailers, but the narrow plots and upper floors still reveal its mews-like working origins.
places.descriptionIt: Pavilion Road nacque come strada di servizio per le grandi case di Sloane Street e Cadogan Square. Le vetrine in mattoni restaurate ospitano oggi artigiani del cibo e negozi indipendenti, ma i lotti stretti e i piani superiori rivelano ancora l’origine da mews.

places.hookIt: Botteghe alimentari artigiane occupano la restaurata strada di servizio dietro le grandi case di Sloane Street.

places.name: Piccadilly Circus
places.description: Piccadilly Circus was created in 1819 at the junction of Regent Street and Piccadilly. The illuminated advertising screens, Shaftesbury Memorial fountain and curving façades make it a constantly changing hinge between Soho, theatreland and the grand West End avenues.
places.descriptionIt: Piccadilly Circus nacque nel 1819 all’incrocio tra Regent Street e Piccadilly. Schermi pubblicitari luminosi, fontana dello Shaftesbury Memorial e facciate curve ne fanno una cerniera in continuo cambiamento tra Soho, teatri e grandi viali del West End.

places.hook: Neon screens and curving Regency façades collide at the West End’s most recognisable junction.
places.hookIt: Schermi al neon e facciate Regency curve si incontrano nel nodo più riconoscibile del West End.

places.name: Pont Street Mews
places.description: Pont Street Mews is a Belgravia stable lane behind the red-brick mansion blocks and ‘Pont Street Dutch’ houses of the surrounding district. Converted coach houses, painted doors and carriage arches retain the smaller scale of the service network behind elite Victorian homes.
places.descriptionIt: Pont Street Mews è un vicolo di scuderie di Belgravia dietro i palazzi in mattoni rossi e le case “Pont Street Dutch”. Rimesse convertite, porte dipinte e archi carrabili conservano la scala ridotta della rete di servizio delle dimore vittoriane.

places.hook: Coach houses preserve the small-scale service world behind Belgravia’s distinctive red-brick mansions.
places.hookIt: Le rimesse conservano il mondo di servizio in scala ridotta dietro le caratteristiche dimore in mattoni rossi di Belgravia.

places.name: Portobello Road
places.description: Portobello Road runs through the heart of Notting Hill and hosts one of London’s best-known street markets. Antiques arcades, fruit stalls, Caribbean and Portuguese influences, pastel terraces and traces of the old Portobello farm create different characters along its length.
places.descriptionIt: Portobello Road attraversa il cuore di Notting Hill e ospita uno dei mercati di strada più noti di Londra. Gallerie di antiquariato, frutta, influenze caraibiche e portoghesi, terrazze pastello e tracce dell’antica fattoria creano caratteri diversi lungo il percorso.

places.hook: Antiques, food stalls and colourful terraces change character block by block along Portobello Road.
places.hookIt: Antiquariato, bancarelle e terrazze colorate cambiano carattere isolato dopo isolato lungo Portobello Road.

places.name: Prime Meridian
places.description: The Prime Meridian at Greenwich marks longitude 0°, the reference adopted internationally in 1884. A brass line in the Royal Observatory courtyard and a laser projected north after dark make the abstract division between eastern and western hemispheres physically visible.
places.descriptionIt: Il meridiano di Greenwich segna la longitudine 0°, riferimento adottato a livello internazionale nel 1884. Una linea d’ottone nel cortile del Royal Observatory e un laser proiettato verso nord dopo il tramonto rendono visibile la divisione tra emisferi.

places.hook: Stand across longitude zero where global time and mapping were given a common reference line.
places.hookIt: Mettiti a cavallo della longitudine zero, dove tempo e cartografia mondiali ricevettero una linea di riferimento comune.

places.name: Princelet st
places.description: Princelet Street preserves some of Spitalfields’ finest early-eighteenth-century houses, built for Huguenot silk weavers. No. 19 later became a synagogue and is now a museum project, while surviving attics, shutters and workshop windows show how domestic life and textile production overlapped.
places.descriptionIt: Princelet Street conserva alcune delle migliori case del primo Settecento di Spitalfields, costruite per tessitori di seta ugonotti. Il civico 19 divenne poi sinagoga, mentre soffitte, persiane e finestre da laboratorio mostrano l’intreccio tra casa e produzione.

places.hook: Huguenot silk-weavers’ houses and a former synagogue compress centuries of migration into one Georgian street.
places.hookIt: Case di tessitori ugonotti e un’ex sinagoga concentrano secoli di migrazione in una sola strada georgiana.

places.name: Princes Gate Mews
places.description: Princes Gate Mews served the grand mid-Victorian terraces facing Hyde Park and Exhibition Road. Converted coach houses retain brickwork, carriage arches and traces of hayloft openings, offering a small-scale counterpoint to nearby museums and diplomatic buildings.
places.descriptionIt: Princes Gate Mews serviva le grandi terrazze vittoriane affacciate su Hyde Park ed Exhibition Road. Le rimesse convertite conservano mattoni, archi carrabili e tracce dei fienili, offrendo un contrappunto in scala ridotta a musei e sedi diplomatiche.

places.hook: Former stables preserve a quiet service lane behind South Kensington’s museums and diplomatic terraces.
places.hookIt: Antiche scuderie conservano un tranquillo vicolo di servizio dietro musei e terrazze diplomatiche di South Kensington.

places.name: Princess Mews
places.description: Princess Mews is a discreet Belsize Park lane of converted stables and workshops. Brick façades, broad former carriage doors and compact upper floors preserve the practical architecture that served the larger villas and terraces of the nineteenth-century suburb.
places.descriptionIt: Princess Mews è un discreto vicolo di Belsize Park con scuderie e laboratori convertiti. Facciate in mattoni, ampie porte carrabili e piani superiori compatti conservano l’architettura pratica al servizio delle ville e terrazze ottocentesche.

places.hook: Converted stables reveal the working lane behind Belsize Park’s larger Victorian homes.
places.hookIt: Scuderie convertite rivelano il vicolo operativo dietro le più grandi case vittoriane di Belsize Park.

places.name: Pullens Yards
places.description: The Pullens Estate is one of London’s last surviving Victorian tenement developments with purpose-built workshop yards. Repeated brick balconies surround compact flats, while Clements, Peacock and Iliffe Yards still support makers and open their studios on occasional weekends.
places.descriptionIt: Il Pullens Estate è uno degli ultimi complessi popolari vittoriani di Londra con cortili-laboratorio costruiti appositamente. Balconi in mattoni circondano piccoli appartamenti, mentre Clements, Peacock e Iliffe Yards ospitano ancora artigiani e aperture periodiche.

places.hook: Victorian tenements and working craft yards survive together in an exceptional Walworth enclave.
places.hookIt: Case popolari vittoriane e cortili artigiani ancora attivi sopravvivono insieme in un’eccezionale enclave di Walworth.

places.name: Puma Court
places.description: Puma Court is a narrow Spitalfields passage running beside the former Truman Brewery complex. Modest brick houses and workshop remnants reflect the neighbourhood’s layers of Huguenot, Jewish and Bengali settlement away from the commercial intensity of Brick Lane.
places.descriptionIt: Puma Court è uno stretto passaggio di Spitalfields accanto all’ex complesso Truman Brewery. Modeste case in mattoni e resti di laboratori riflettono gli strati di insediamento ugonotto, ebraico e bengalese lontano dall’intensità commerciale di Brick Lane.

places.hook: A narrow passage beside Brick Lane preserves the domestic scale of Spitalfields’ successive migrant communities.
places.hookIt: Uno stretto passaggio accanto a Brick Lane conserva la scala domestica delle successive comunità migranti di Spitalfields.

places.name: Regent Street
places.description: Regent Street was planned by John Nash from 1811 as a ceremonial and commercial route linking Carlton House with Regent’s Park. The present sweeping Portland-stone façades largely date from the early twentieth century, preserving Nash’s curve while creating monumental unified shopfronts.
places.descriptionIt: Regent Street fu progettata da John Nash dal 1811 come percorso cerimoniale e commerciale tra Carlton House e Regent’s Park. Le attuali facciate curve in pietra di Portland risalgono soprattutto al primo Novecento, conservando la curva di Nash con fronti monumentali.

places.hook: A great Portland-stone curve preserves John Nash’s ceremonial route through the modern West End.
places.hookIt: Una grande curva in pietra di Portland conserva il percorso cerimoniale di John Nash nel moderno West End.

places.name: Richmond
places.description: Richmond developed around a royal palace and a Thames crossing, retaining a compact Georgian centre between the river and Richmond Hill. Riverside terraces, lanes, the Green and views protected by Act of Parliament connect town life with the vast landscape of Richmond Park.
places.descriptionIt: Richmond si sviluppò attorno a un palazzo reale e a un attraversamento del Tamigi, conservando un centro georgiano compatto tra fiume e collina. Terrazze fluviali, vicoli, il Green e viste protette per legge collegano la città al vasto Richmond Park.

places.hook: A Georgian riverside town rises toward one of London’s most carefully protected panoramic views.
places.hookIt: Una città georgiana sul fiume sale verso una delle viste panoramiche più protette di Londra.

places.name: River Neckinger
places.description: The River Neckinger is one of London’s largely hidden waterways, rising around Southwark and flowing toward St Saviour’s Dock. Its sinister name is often linked to the ‘devil’s neckcloth’ of the old gallows, while fragments of the channel survive around Bermondsey’s former tanneries.
places.descriptionIt: Il River Neckinger è uno dei corsi d’acqua quasi interamente nascosti di Londra, nato a Southwark e diretto a St Saviour’s Dock. Il nome sinistro è legato al “fazzoletto del diavolo” del patibolo, mentre frammenti del canale restano tra le antiche concerie di Bermondsey.

places.hook: A buried river with a gallows-linked name still surfaces among Bermondsey’s former warehouses and tanneries.
places.hookIt: Un fiume sotterraneo dal nome legato al patibolo riaffiora tra gli antichi magazzini e le concerie di Bermondsey.

places.name: Roupell Street
places.description: Roupell Street was developed from the 1820s by the Roupell family on former marshland near Waterloo. Almost continuous rows of modest yellow-brick houses, original fanlights and corner pubs survived bombing and redevelopment, creating an exceptional early-nineteenth-century workers’ streetscape.
places.descriptionIt: Roupell Street fu sviluppata dagli anni 1820 dalla famiglia Roupell su antiche paludi vicino Waterloo. File quasi continue di modeste case in mattoni gialli, sopraluci originali e pub d’angolo sono sopravvissuti a bombe e ricostruzioni, formando un raro paesaggio operaio.

places.hook: Yellow-brick workers’ terraces survive almost intact behind Waterloo in a remarkable nineteenth-century time capsule.
places.hookIt: Terrazze operaie in mattoni gialli sopravvivono quasi intatte dietro Waterloo come straordinaria capsula ottocentesca.

places.name: Royal Crescent
places.description: Royal Crescent in Holland Park was built in the 1840s as a grand stucco composition modelled on the crescent form popularised in Bath. Its paired curves frame a private garden and terminate in projecting end blocks, creating a formal western gateway to Notting Hill.
places.descriptionIt: Royal Crescent a Holland Park fu costruita negli anni 1840 come grande composizione in stucco ispirata alle mezzelune di Bath. Le due curve incorniciano un giardino privato e terminano in blocchi sporgenti, creando un ingresso formale a Notting Hill.

places.hook: Twin stucco curves create a formal Victorian answer to Bath’s famous crescents in west London.
places.hookIt: Due curve in stucco creano nella Londra occidentale una risposta vittoriana alle celebri mezzelune di Bath.

places.name: Ruislip Lido Beach
places.description: Ruislip Lido is a reservoir opened in 1811 to feed the Grand Junction Canal and later reinvented as a suburban leisure lake. Its sandy beach, surrounding woodland and twelve-inch-gauge miniature railway create an improbable seaside atmosphere at the edge of northwest London.
places.descriptionIt: Ruislip Lido è un bacino aperto nel 1811 per alimentare il Grand Junction Canal e poi trasformato in lago ricreativo suburbano. Spiaggia sabbiosa, boschi e ferrovia in miniatura a scartamento ridotto creano un’improbabile atmosfera balneare ai margini nord-occidentali.

places.hook: A canal reservoir became a woodland beach resort complete with Britain’s longest miniature railway.
places.hookIt: Un bacino per canali è diventato una località balneare nel bosco con una lunga ferrovia in miniatura.

places.name: Saint Helen's Place
places.description: St Helen’s Place is a short gated City street beside the medieval church of St Helen Bishopsgate. Restrained nineteenth-century offices, livery connections and glimpses of the church form a protected enclave immediately behind the towers and traffic of Bishopsgate.
places.descriptionIt: St Helen’s Place è una breve strada con accesso controllato accanto alla chiesa medievale di St Helen Bishopsgate. Sobri uffici ottocenteschi, legami con le corporazioni e scorci della chiesa formano un’enclave protetta dietro torri e traffico di Bishopsgate.

places.hookIt: Un’enclave chiusa della City conserva un tranquillo accesso alla medievale St Helen’s sotto le torri moderne.

places.name: Seven Dials
places.description: Seven Dials was laid out in the 1690s by Thomas Neale, with seven streets radiating from a central column. Restored late-seventeenth- and eighteenth-century buildings, small shops and theatres make the star-shaped plan easy to read at pedestrian scale.
places.descriptionIt: Seven Dials fu progettata negli anni 1690 da Thomas Neale, con sette strade a raggiera da una colonna centrale. Edifici restaurati del Sei e Settecento, piccoli negozi e teatri rendono leggibile a piedi la pianta a stella.

places.hookIt: Sette strade si irradiano da una colonna-meridiana restaurata in una delle piante barocche più leggibili di Londra.

places.name: Seymour Place - Gingko
places.description: The mature ginkgo on Seymour Place brings striking fan-shaped leaves and intense autumn colour to a dense Marylebone street. Its survival among nineteenth-century terraces and modern traffic offers a useful reminder that individual trees can become local landmarks in their own right.
places.descriptionIt: Il ginkgo maturo di Seymour Place porta foglie a ventaglio e un intenso colore autunnale in una densa strada di Marylebone. La sua presenza tra terrazze ottocentesche e traffico moderno ricorda che anche un singolo albero può diventare un riferimento locale.

places.hook: A mature ginkgo turns brilliant yellow each autumn against Marylebone’s brick and stucco terraces.
places.hookIt: Un ginkgo maturo diventa giallo brillante ogni autunno contro le terrazze in mattoni e stucco di Marylebone.

places.name: Shepherd Market
places.description: Shepherd Market was laid out in the 1730s by Edward Shepherd on the site of the annual May Fair that gave Mayfair its name. Narrow lanes, small eighteenth-century houses, pubs and independent shops preserve a village-like pocket behind Piccadilly.
places.descriptionIt: Shepherd Market fu progettato negli anni 1730 da Edward Shepherd sul sito della fiera di maggio che diede nome a Mayfair. Vicoli, piccole case settecentesche, pub e negozi indipendenti conservano un angolo dall’atmosfera di villaggio dietro Piccadilly.

places.hook: The old May Fair survives in name and street pattern within this intimate eighteenth-century market enclave.
places.hookIt: L’antica May Fair sopravvive nel nome e nella trama urbana di questa intima enclave settecentesca.

places.name: Shepherdess Walk Mosaics
places.description: The Shepherdess Walk mosaics were created with local residents to tell the history of Hoxton and Shoreditch. Colourful panels embedded along the route depict trades, housing, wartime experience and community life, turning an ordinary pavement into a distributed neighbourhood archive.
places.descriptionIt: I mosaici di Shepherdess Walk furono creati con i residenti per raccontare Hoxton e Shoreditch. Pannelli colorati lungo il percorso raffigurano mestieri, case, guerra e vita comunitaria, trasformando un normale marciapiede in un archivio diffuso del quartiere.

places.hook: Community-made mosaics turn a Hoxton pavement into a colourful archive of local work and daily life.
places.hookIt: Mosaici realizzati dalla comunità trasformano un marciapiede di Hoxton in un archivio colorato di lavoro e vita quotidiana.

places.name: Sicilian Avenue
places.description: Sicilian Avenue was completed in 1910 as an ornate pedestrian approach to Southampton Row. Marble columns, urns, gilded lettering and theatrical arches turn a short shopping arcade into an exuberant piece of Edwardian commercial design.
places.descriptionIt: Sicilian Avenue fu completata nel 1910 come elegante accesso pedonale a Southampton Row. Colonne di marmo, urne, scritte dorate e archi teatrali trasformano una breve galleria commerciale in un’esuberante opera edoardiana.

places.hookIt: Colonne di marmo e archi dorati rendono questa piccola galleria edoardiana sorprendentemente teatrale.

places.name: Smith's Court
places.description: Smith’s Court is one of Soho’s narrow passages between Brewer Street and the surrounding entertainment district. Its small shop units and service entrances preserve the compressed grain of workshops and trades that developed behind the neighbourhood’s main commercial streets.
places.descriptionIt: Smith’s Court è uno degli stretti passaggi di Soho tra Brewer Street e il quartiere dei locali. Piccole unità commerciali e ingressi di servizio conservano la trama compressa di laboratori e mestieri sviluppati dietro le principali strade commerciali.

places.hookIt: Una corte stretta conserva la scala dei laboratori dietro le più luminose strade commerciali di Soho.

places.name: Southall
places.description: Southall is a major centre of British Punjabi and Sikh life, shaped by post-war migration and the industries around Heathrow and west London. South Road and The Broadway concentrate gurdwaras, sari shops, sweet makers, spice merchants and restaurants in one of London’s strongest South Asian high streets.
places.descriptionIt: Southall è un grande centro della vita punjabi e sikh britannica, formato dalla migrazione del dopoguerra e dalle industrie dell’ovest londinese. South Road e The Broadway concentrano gurdwara, sari, dolci, spezie e ristoranti in una delle più forti high street sud-asiatiche.

places.hook: Gurdwaras, sari shops and Punjabi food make Southall one of London’s most distinctive South Asian town centres.
places.hookIt: Gurdwara, negozi di sari e cucina punjabi fanno di Southall uno dei centri sud-asiatici più caratteristici di Londra.

places.name: St John's Smith Square
places.description: Smith Square is organised around the former church of St John’s, Nicholas Hawksmoor’s 1720s Baroque masterpiece now used as a concert venue. Georgian houses and quiet approaches create an unexpectedly formal enclave between Westminster’s political institutions and the Thames.
places.descriptionIt: Smith Square è organizzata attorno all’ex chiesa di St John’s, capolavoro barocco di Nicholas Hawksmoor degli anni 1720, oggi sala da concerto. Case georgiane e accessi tranquilli creano un’enclave formale tra le istituzioni di Westminster e il Tamigi.

places.hook: Hawksmoor’s four-towered Baroque church dominates a quiet Georgian square near Parliament.
places.hookIt: La chiesa barocca a quattro torri di Hawksmoor domina una tranquilla piazza georgiana vicino al Parlamento.

places.name: St Katharine Docks Marina
places.description: St Katharine Docks opened in 1828 to designs by Thomas Telford, replacing a dense medieval neighbourhood beside the Tower. Restored warehouses, narrow quays, boats and the central basin preserve the scale of a working enclosed dock within a modern marina.
places.descriptionIt: St Katharine Docks aprì nel 1828 su progetto di Thomas Telford, sostituendo un denso quartiere medievale accanto alla Torre. Magazzini restaurati, banchine strette, barche e bacino centrale conservano la scala di un porto chiuso trasformato in marina.

places.hook: Telford’s enclosed dock survives as a marina of boats and restored warehouses beside the Tower of London.
places.hookIt: Il bacino chiuso di Telford sopravvive come marina di barche e magazzini restaurati accanto alla Torre di Londra.

places.name: Stamford Hill quartiere ebraico
places.description: Stamford Hill is home to Europe’s largest concentration of Haredi Jewish communities, established through successive migrations during the twentieth century. Synagogues, schools, kosher shops and family life shape the streets, where visitors should remember they are entering a living religious neighbourhood rather than an attraction.
places.descriptionIt: Stamford Hill ospita la maggiore concentrazione europea di comunità ebraiche haredi, formata da successive migrazioni nel Novecento. Sinagoghe, scuole, negozi kosher e vita familiare definiscono le strade, da visitare ricordando che è un quartiere religioso vivo, non un’attrazione.
places.accessNotes: Public street or outdoor public realm. Access is generally unrestricted, but individual shops, courtyards and buildings keep their own hours and may be private.

places.hook: Synagogues, schools and kosher shops make Stamford Hill a living centre of Haredi Jewish London.
places.hookIt: Sinagoghe, scuole e negozi kosher fanno di Stamford Hill un centro vivo della Londra ebraica haredi.

places.name: Stanley Crescent
places.description: Stanley Crescent curves around one of the private communal gardens planned across the Ladbroke Estate. White stucco terraces, classical details and mature planting create a particularly coherent Notting Hill composition, linked visually and historically to nearby Kensington Park Gardens.
places.descriptionIt: Stanley Crescent curva attorno a uno dei giardini condominiali privati progettati nel Ladbroke Estate. Terrazze bianche in stucco, dettagli classici e alberi maturi formano una composizione molto coerente di Notting Hill, legata a Kensington Park Gardens.

places.hook: White stucco terraces sweep around a private garden in one of Notting Hill’s most coherent estate compositions.
places.hookIt: Terrazze bianche in stucco curvano attorno a un giardino privato in una delle composizioni più coerenti di Notting Hill.

places.name: Stepping Stones Walk
places.description: The Stepping Stones cross the River Mole below Box Hill, forming a playful link on walking routes through the Surrey Hills. Their modern concrete blocks follow a long-established crossing beneath wooded slopes and chalk downland, but water levels and flooding can make them impassable.
places.descriptionIt: Le Stepping Stones attraversano il River Mole sotto Box Hill e formano un collegamento suggestivo nei percorsi delle Surrey Hills. I moderni blocchi di cemento seguono un antico guado ai piedi di boschi e colline di gesso, ma piene e livelli alti possono renderli impraticabili.

places.hook: Concrete stepping stones carry walkers across the River Mole beneath the wooded slopes of Box Hill.
places.hookIt: Pietre in cemento portano i camminatori attraverso il River Mole sotto i pendii boscosi di Box Hill.

places.name: Stewart's Grove
places.description: Stewart’s Grove is a quiet Chelsea street of nineteenth-century cottages and former service buildings between Fulham Road and Old Brompton Road. Its modest brick and stucco façades preserve a domestic scale distinct from the larger terraces and mansion blocks nearby.
places.descriptionIt: Stewart’s Grove è una tranquilla strada di Chelsea con cottage ottocenteschi ed ex edifici di servizio tra Fulham Road e Old Brompton Road. Le modeste facciate in mattoni e stucco conservano una scala domestica diversa dalle grandi terrazze e palazzi vicini.

places.hook: Modest cottages preserve a small domestic scale between Chelsea’s larger terraces and mansion blocks.
places.hookIt: Modesti cottage conservano una piccola scala domestica tra le grandi terrazze e i palazzi di Chelsea.

places.name: Tea Trade Wharf
places.description: Tea Trade Wharf forms part of the Shad Thames warehouse complex where imported tea and spices were once stored beside Butler’s Wharf. Heavy brick walls, iron bridges and narrow canyon-like streets preserve the physical infrastructure of London’s former river trade.
places.descriptionIt: Tea Trade Wharf appartiene al complesso di magazzini di Shad Thames, dove tè e spezie importati venivano conservati vicino Butler’s Wharf. Pesanti muri in mattoni, ponti in ferro e strade strette conservano l’infrastruttura del commercio fluviale londinese.
places.accessNotes: Public street or outdoor public realm. Access is generally unrestricted, but individual shops, courtyards and buildings keep their own hours and may be private.
places.accessNotesIt: Strada o spazio pubblico all’aperto. L’accesso è generalmente libero, ma negozi, cortili ed edifici hanno orari propri e possono essere privati.
places.hook: Iron bridges and massive warehouses preserve the architecture of London’s tea trade beside the Thames.
places.hookIt: Ponti in ferro e grandi magazzini conservano l’architettura del commercio londinese del tè sul Tamigi.

places.name: Thames Beach
places.description: At low tide, a strip of foreshore appears on the South Bank below the river wall. Shingle, worn pottery and river-smoothed fragments reveal the Thames as a tidal working landscape, but access can be slippery and mudlarking or removing objects requires the appropriate permit.
places.descriptionIt: Con la bassa marea emerge una striscia di riva sotto il muro della South Bank. Ghiaia, ceramiche consumate e frammenti levigati mostrano il Tamigi come paesaggio di lavoro soggetto alle maree; l’accesso è scivoloso e cercare o rimuovere oggetti richiede permesso.
places.accessNotes: This is best appreciated from the public realm. Some adjoining land or interiors are private, restricted or available only during occasional open days.

places.hook: Low tide exposes a temporary beach of shingle and river-worn traces beneath the South Bank.
places.hookIt: La bassa marea espone una spiaggia temporanea di ghiaia e tracce levigate dal fiume sotto la South Bank.

places.name: The London Peace Pagoda
places.description: The London Peace Pagoda was completed in Battersea Park in 1985 by monks and supporters of the Nipponzan-Myōhōji Buddhist order. Four gilded Buddha figures face the cardinal directions from the white riverside structure, which remains a focus for peace ceremonies and quiet reflection.
places.descriptionIt: La London Peace Pagoda fu completata a Battersea Park nel 1985 da monaci e sostenitori dell’ordine buddhista Nipponzan-Myōhōji. Quattro Buddha dorati guardano i punti cardinali dalla struttura bianca sul fiume, centro di cerimonie per la pace e raccoglimento.

places.accessNotesIt: Sito all’aperto con orari che possono variare secondo la stagione. Controlla la fonte ufficiale per orari, chiusure e possibili limitazioni prima di partire.
places.hook: Four gilded Buddhas face across the Thames from a white peace pagoda in Battersea Park.
places.hookIt: Quattro Buddha dorati guardano verso il Tamigi da una pagoda bianca della pace a Battersea Park.

places.name: The Maze
places.description: The Maze at Crystal Palace Park is one of Britain’s largest surviving hedge mazes, first planted in the 1870s. Its circular hornbeam paths were restored with community involvement and include a central feature celebrating the Girl Guides, who trace an early rally to the park.
places.descriptionIt: Il Maze di Crystal Palace Park è uno dei più grandi labirinti di siepi superstiti in Gran Bretagna, piantato negli anni 1870. I percorsi circolari di carpino sono stati restaurati con la comunità e includono un elemento centrale dedicato alle Girl Guides.
places.accessNotes: Outdoor site with opening times that can vary seasonally. Check the official source for current hours, closures and any restrictions before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Sito all’aperto con orari che possono variare secondo la stagione. Controlla la fonte ufficiale per orari, chiusure e possibili limitazioni prima di partire.
places.hook: A restored Victorian hornbeam maze hides a Girl Guides memorial at its centre in Crystal Palace Park.
places.hookIt: Un labirinto vittoriano restaurato di carpino nasconde al centro un memoriale alle Girl Guides nel Crystal Palace Park.

places.name: The Sherriff Centre
places.description: The Sherriff Centre occupies the Grade II-listed St James Church in West Hampstead. A post office, café, soft-play area and community services operate beneath the church’s Victorian arches, creating an unusual shared space that keeps both worship and everyday local facilities under one roof.
places.descriptionIt: The Sherriff Centre occupa la chiesa di St James, tutelata di grado II, a West Hampstead. Ufficio postale, caffè, area giochi e servizi comunitari funzionano sotto gli archi vittoriani, mantenendo culto e strutture quotidiane sotto lo stesso tetto.
places.accessNotes: Access depends on the venue’s opening hours, programme and security arrangements. Check the official site before travelling, especially for interiors, events or guided visits.
places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso dipende da orari, programma e controlli del luogo. Controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire, soprattutto per interni, eventi o visite guidate.
places.hook: A post office, café and children’s play space operate inside a working Victorian church in West Hampstead.
places.hookIt: Ufficio postale, caffè e area giochi funzionano dentro una chiesa vittoriana attiva a West Hampstead.

places.name: The Stafford London
places.description: The Stafford London is arranged around Blue Ball Yard, a cobbled courtyard entered discreetly from St James’s Place. Former stables, wine cellars used as wartime shelters and a collection of historical artefacts give the hotel an unusually layered connection to old St James’s.
places.descriptionIt: The Stafford London è organizzato attorno a Blue Ball Yard, cortile acciottolato con ingresso discreto da St James’s Place. Antiche scuderie, cantine usate come rifugi in guerra e oggetti storici danno all’hotel un legame stratificato con la vecchia St James’s.
places.accessNotes: Access depends on the venue’s opening hours, programme and security arrangements. Check the official site before travelling, especially for interiors, events or guided visits.
places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso dipende da orari, programma e controlli del luogo. Controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire, soprattutto per interni, eventi o visite guidate.
places.hook: A hidden cobbled yard links former stables and wartime wine cellars behind St James’s Palace.
places.hookIt: Un cortile acciottolato nascosto collega antiche scuderie e cantine-rifugio dietro St James’s Palace.

places.name: Tower Bridge view
places.description: The riverside west of Tower Bridge gives a close oblique view of the bridge’s twin Gothic Revival towers, bascules and suspended walkways. River traffic and the contrasting City skyline make this one of the clearest places to understand the bridge as both working infrastructure and theatrical architecture.
places.descriptionIt: La riva a ovest di Tower Bridge offre una vista ravvicinata e obliqua sulle torri neogotiche, le bascule e le passerelle sospese. Traffico fluviale e skyline della City aiutano a leggere il ponte come infrastruttura funzionante e architettura teatrale.

places.hook: A close riverside angle reveals Tower Bridge’s bascules, suspended walkways and working relationship with the Thames.
places.hookIt: Un’angolazione ravvicinata dal fiume rivela bascule, passerelle sospese e rapporto operativo di Tower Bridge con il Tamigi.

places.name: Trident Studios Bowie's plaque
places.description: The plaque at 17 St Anne’s Court marks Trident Studios, where a converted eighteenth-century building became one of Soho’s most important recording spaces. David Bowie recorded ‘Space Oddity’ and much of ‘Hunky Dory’ here, alongside sessions by the Beatles, Queen and Elton John.
places.descriptionIt: La targa al 17 St Anne’s Court indica i Trident Studios, dove un edificio settecentesco convertito divenne uno dei più importanti studi di Soho. David Bowie registrò qui “Space Oddity” e gran parte di “Hunky Dory”, insieme a Beatles, Queen ed Elton John.
places.accessNotes: Public street or outdoor public realm. Access is generally unrestricted, but individual shops, courtyards and buildings keep their own hours and may be private.
places.accessNotesIt: Strada o spazio pubblico all’aperto. L’accesso è generalmente libero, ma negozi, cortili ed edifici hanno orari propri e possono essere privati.
places.hook: A modest Soho doorway marks the studio where Bowie recorded ‘Space Oddity’ and Queen made early albums.
places.hookIt: Una modesta porta di Soho indica lo studio dove Bowie registrò “Space Oddity” e i Queen realizzarono i primi album.

places.name: Turin Street
places.description: Turin Street follows a useful north–south line through Bethnal Green between Gosset Street and the Brick Lane side of Cheshire Street. Originally divided between Hope Town and Union Street, it was unified under its present name after 1864; surviving nineteenth-century terraces lead towards St Matthew’s Row and the eighteenth-century parish church.
places.descriptionIt: Turin Street segue un utile asse nord-sud attraverso Bethnal Green, tra Gosset Street e Cheshire Street verso Brick Lane. In origine divisa tra Hope Town e Union Street, assunse il nome attuale dopo il 1864; le case ottocentesche superstiti conducono verso St Matthew’s Row e la chiesa parrocchiale settecentesca.
places.accessNotes: Public residential street. The interest is in the surviving streetscape and route rather than a single attraction; be considerate around homes, schools and the small gated garden near St Matthew’s Row.
places.accessNotesIt: Strada residenziale pubblica. L’interesse è nel paesaggio urbano e nel percorso, non in una singola attrazione; rispetta abitazioni, scuole e il piccolo giardino recintato vicino a St Matthew’s Row.
places.hook: A modest Bethnal Green street links Victorian terraces, an old parish route and the quieter approach to Brick Lane.
places.hookIt: Una modesta strada di Bethnal Green unisce case vittoriane, un antico percorso parrocchiale e l’accesso più tranquillo a Brick Lane.

places.name: Wallgrave Road
places.description: Wallgrave Road is a short Kensington residential street of compact nineteenth-century houses near Earl’s Court Road. Brick and stucco façades, shallow front gardens and the intimate width preserve a quieter domestic layer behind the area’s larger squares and mansion blocks.
places.descriptionIt: Wallgrave Road è una breve strada residenziale di Kensington con case ottocentesche compatte vicino Earl’s Court Road. Facciate in mattoni e stucco, piccoli giardini e larghezza intima conservano uno strato domestico più tranquillo dietro grandi piazze e palazzi.
places.accessNotes: Public street or outdoor public realm. Access is generally unrestricted, but individual shops, courtyards and buildings keep their own hours and may be private.
places.accessNotesIt: Strada o spazio pubblico all’aperto. L’accesso è generalmente libero, ma negozi, cortili ed edifici hanno orari propri e possono essere privati.
places.hook: Compact nineteenth-century houses preserve a quiet domestic street behind Earl’s Court’s larger developments.
places.hookIt: Compatte case ottocentesche conservano una tranquilla strada domestica dietro i maggiori sviluppi di Earl’s Court.

places.name: Walthamstow village
places.description: Walthamstow Village centres on St Mary’s Church, Vestry House Museum and the timber-framed Ancient House. Georgian and Victorian streets, almshouses and independent businesses preserve the core of an old Essex settlement now surrounded by northeast London.
places.descriptionIt: Walthamstow Village ruota attorno a St Mary’s Church, Vestry House Museum e alla Ancient House a graticcio. Strade georgiane e vittoriane, almshouse e attività indipendenti conservano il nucleo di un antico insediamento dell’Essex oggi dentro Londra.
places.accessNotes: Public street or outdoor public realm. Access is generally unrestricted, but individual shops, courtyards and buildings keep their own hours and may be private.
places.accessNotesIt: Strada o spazio pubblico all’aperto. L’accesso è generalmente libero, ma negozi, cortili ed edifici hanno orari propri e possono essere privati.
places.hook: A timber-framed house, medieval church and old workhouse preserve Walthamstow’s Essex village core.
places.hookIt: Una casa a graticcio, una chiesa medievale e l’antica workhouse conservano il nucleo di villaggio dell’Essex a Walthamstow.

places.name: Warren Mews
places.description: Warren Mews is a compact Fitzrovia service lane behind the medical and residential terraces of Warren Street. Converted workshops and coach houses retain broad ground-floor openings and mixed brickwork, reflecting the district’s long combination of small industry and housing.
places.descriptionIt: Warren Mews è un compatto vicolo di servizio di Fitzrovia dietro le terrazze mediche e residenziali di Warren Street. Laboratori e rimesse convertiti conservano ampie aperture e mattoni diversi, riflettendo la storica mescolanza di piccola industria e abitazioni.
places.accessNotes: Public street or outdoor public realm. Access is generally unrestricted, but individual shops, courtyards and buildings keep their own hours and may be private.
places.accessNotesIt: Strada o spazio pubblico all’aperto. L’accesso è generalmente libero, ma negozi, cortili ed edifici hanno orari propri e possono essere privati.
places.hook: Converted workshops preserve Fitzrovia’s mixture of small industry and housing behind Warren Street.
places.hookIt: Laboratori convertiti conservano la mescolanza di piccola industria e abitazioni di Fitzrovia dietro Warren Street.

places.name: Whittlesey Street
places.description: Whittlesey Street preserves a row of early-nineteenth-century houses in Waterloo’s Roupell Street conservation area. Yellow stock brick, fanlights and simple proportions continue the remarkably intact workers’ neighbourhood built by the Roupell family on former marshland.
places.descriptionIt: Whittlesey Street conserva una fila di case del primo Ottocento nell’area protetta di Roupell Street a Waterloo. Mattoni gialli, sopraluci e proporzioni semplici continuano il quartiere operaio eccezionalmente integro costruito dai Roupell su antiche paludi.
places.accessNotes: Public street or outdoor public realm. Access is generally unrestricted, but individual shops, courtyards and buildings keep their own hours and may be private.
places.accessNotesIt: Strada o spazio pubblico all’aperto. L’accesso è generalmente libero, ma negozi, cortili ed edifici hanno orari propri e possono essere privati.
places.hook: Yellow-brick workers’ houses extend Waterloo’s remarkably intact Roupell Street time capsule.
places.hookIt: Case operaie in mattoni gialli prolungano la straordinaria capsula ottocentesca di Roupell Street a Waterloo.

places.name: Wimbledon Village
places.description: Wimbledon Village grew around the medieval parish on the hill above the railway town. Georgian houses, independent shops, pubs and the edge of Wimbledon Common create a distinct centre, with horse riders still passing through on routes between local stables and the open land.
places.descriptionIt: Wimbledon Village si sviluppò attorno alla parrocchia medievale sulla collina sopra la città ferroviaria. Case georgiane, negozi indipendenti, pub e il margine del Common formano un centro distinto, ancora attraversato da cavalieri provenienti dalle scuderie locali.
places.accessNotes: Public street or outdoor public realm. Access is generally unrestricted, but individual shops, courtyards and buildings keep their own hours and may be private.
places.accessNotesIt: Strada o spazio pubblico all’aperto. L’accesso è generalmente libero, ma negozi, cortili ed edifici hanno orari propri e possono essere privati.
places.hook: Georgian streets, independent shops and passing horses mark the hilltop threshold of Wimbledon Common.
places.hookIt: Strade georgiane, negozi indipendenti e cavalli di passaggio segnano la soglia collinare di Wimbledon Common.

places.name: Woburn Walk
places.description: Woburn Walk was designed by Thomas Cubitt in 1822 as one of London’s earliest purpose-built pedestrian shopping streets. Its bowed shop windows, stucco façades and sheltered scale survive near Euston, with literary associations including W. B. Yeats and Dorothy L. Sayers.
places.descriptionIt: Woburn Walk fu progettata da Thomas Cubitt nel 1822 come una delle prime strade commerciali pedonali costruite appositamente a Londra. Vetrine curve, facciate in stucco e scala raccolta sopravvivono vicino Euston, con legami con W. B. Yeats e Dorothy L. Sayers.
places.accessNotes: Public street or outdoor public realm. Access is generally unrestricted, but individual shops, courtyards and buildings keep their own hours and may be private.
places.accessNotesIt: Strada o spazio pubblico all’aperto. L’accesso è generalmente libero, ma negozi, cortili ed edifici hanno orari propri e possono essere privati.
places.hook: Bowed shop windows preserve Thomas Cubitt’s pioneering 1822 pedestrian shopping street near Euston.
places.hookIt: Vetrine curve conservano la pionieristica strada commerciale pedonale progettata da Thomas Cubitt nel 1822 vicino Euston.

places.name: 30 St Mary Axe (The Gherkin)
places.description: 30 St Mary Axe, completed in 2004 by Foster + Partners with Arup, replaced the bomb-damaged Baltic Exchange. Its tapering profile, spiralling light wells and triangulated steel diagrid made the ‘Gherkin’ a landmark of environmentally minded early twenty-first-century office design.
places.descriptionIt: 30 St Mary Axe, completato nel 2004 da Foster + Partners con Arup, sostituì il Baltic Exchange danneggiato da un attentato. Il profilo rastremato, i pozzi di luce a spirale e la maglia diagonale in acciaio hanno reso il “Gherkin” un simbolo dell’architettura sostenibile d’inizio secolo.
places.accessNotes: The exterior is visible from the public realm. The building itself is not a general visitor attraction; respect private entrances, residents and on-site security.
places.accessNotesIt: L’esterno è visibile dallo spazio pubblico. L’edificio non è un’attrazione aperta in generale: rispetta ingressi privati, residenti e controlli di sicurezza.
places.hook: A spiralling steel diagrid gives the Gherkin its instantly recognisable profile and column-free floors.
places.hookIt: Una maglia diagonale d’acciaio crea il profilo inconfondibile del Gherkin e piani privi di colonne.

places.name: AD St C.H.S Public Library
places.description: The surviving public-library inscription and civic detailing preserve the educational ambition of a purpose-built neighbourhood library, even where the building’s present use is less obvious from the street.
places.descriptionIt: L’iscrizione della biblioteca pubblica e i dettagli civici conservano l’ambizione educativa di una biblioteca di quartiere costruita appositamente, anche se l’uso attuale dell’edificio è meno evidente dalla strada.
places.accessNotes: Best appreciated from the public realm; the building is not presented as generally open to visitors. Do not enter private or operational areas.
places.accessNotesIt: Si apprezza soprattutto dallo spazio pubblico; l’edificio non è normalmente visitabile. Non entrare in aree private o operative.
places.hook: The surviving public-library inscription and civic detailing preserve the educational ambition of a purpose-built neighbourhood library, even where the building’s present use is less obvious from the street.
places.hookIt: L’iscrizione della biblioteca pubblica e i dettagli civici conservano l’ambizione educativa di una biblioteca di quartiere costruita appositamente, anche se l’uso attuale dell’edificio è meno evidente dalla strada.

places.name: Apothecaries' Hall
places.description: The Society of Apothecaries established its hall on this site in 1632; most of the present courtyard complex was rebuilt after the Great Fire and completed in 1672. A sober brick exterior conceals a richly panelled Great Hall, court room and laboratory linked to the history of pharmacy and medical education.
places.descriptionIt: La Society of Apothecaries si stabilì qui nel 1632; gran parte dell’attuale complesso a corte fu ricostruita dopo il Grande Incendio e completata nel 1672. Dietro il sobrio mattone si trovano la Great Hall rivestita in legno, la sala del tribunale e il laboratorio legati alla storia della farmacia e della medicina.
places.accessNotes: This is primarily a working or private building and is best appreciated from the public realm. Interior access is limited to authorised visits or occasional open days.
places.accessNotesIt: È soprattutto un edificio operativo o privato, da osservare dallo spazio pubblico. Gli interni sono accessibili solo con autorizzazione o durante aperture occasionali.
places.hook: One of the City’s oldest surviving livery halls hides seventeenth-century rooms behind a quiet courtyard.
places.hookIt: Una delle più antiche sedi delle corporazioni della City nasconde sale seicentesche dietro una corte discreta.

places.name: ArcelorMittal Orbit
places.description: Anish Kapoor and engineer Cecil Balmond designed the 114.5-metre ArcelorMittal Orbit as the sculptural landmark of the 2012 Olympic Park. Its looping red lattice deliberately resists a single viewpoint; Carsten Höller’s later tunnel slide coils around the structure on the descent.
places.descriptionIt: Anish Kapoor e l’ingegnere Cecil Balmond progettarono l’ArcelorMittal Orbit, alto 114,5 metri, come landmark scultoreo del Parco Olimpico del 2012. Il reticolo rosso ad anelli cambia da ogni angolazione; lo scivolo a tubo aggiunto da Carsten Höller avvolge la struttura in discesa.
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: Kapoor’s looping red tower turns engineering into a deliberately unstable-looking Olympic sculpture.
places.hookIt: La torre rossa ad anelli di Kapoor trasforma l’ingegneria in una scultura olimpica volutamente instabile.

places.name: Barbican Estate
places.description: Chamberlin, Powell and Bon designed the Barbican Estate as a raised, traffic-separated city after wartime destruction. Built mainly from the 1960s to the 1980s, its bush-hammered concrete towers, terrace blocks, lake, gardens and elevated walkways form one of Britain’s most ambitious Brutalist residential ensembles.
places.descriptionIt: Chamberlin, Powell and Bon progettarono il Barbican Estate come città sopraelevata e separata dal traffico dopo le distruzioni belliche. Costruito soprattutto tra anni Sessanta e Ottanta, unisce torri in cemento martellinato, blocchi terrazzati, lago, giardini e passerelle in uno dei maggiori complessi brutalisti britannici.
places.accessNotes: The exterior is visible from the public realm. The building itself is not a general visitor attraction; respect private entrances, residents and on-site security.
places.accessNotesIt: L’esterno è visibile dallo spazio pubblico. L’edificio non è un’attrazione aperta in generale: rispetta ingressi privati, residenti e controlli di sicurezza.
places.hook: Concrete towers, lakes and high walks turn a bomb-damaged district into a complete Brutalist cityscape.
places.hookIt: Torri di cemento, laghi e passerelle trasformano un quartiere bombardato in un paesaggio brutalista completo.

places.name: BBC
places.description: Broadcasting House opened in 1932 as the BBC’s purpose-built radio headquarters, designed by George Val Myer in a restrained Art Deco manner. Its curved Portland-stone prow carries Eric Gill’s controversial Prospero and Ariel sculpture; the later John Peel Wing expanded the complex for digital news broadcasting.
places.descriptionIt: Broadcasting House aprì nel 1932 come sede radiofonica appositamente costruita per la BBC, progettata da George Val Myer in sobrio stile Art Déco. La prua curva in pietra di Portland reca la discussa scultura Prospero and Ariel di Eric Gill; la successiva John Peel Wing ampliò il complesso per le notizie digitali.

places.accessNotesIt: È soprattutto un edificio operativo o privato, da osservare dallo spazio pubblico. Gli interni sono accessibili solo con autorizzazione o durante aperture occasionali.
places.hook: The BBC’s stone-clad 1932 radio headquarters still reads like an ocean liner pointed down Regent Street.
places.hookIt: La sede radiofonica della BBC del 1932 sembra ancora un transatlantico di pietra puntato verso Regent Street.

places.name: Beckenham Place Mansion
places.description: Beckenham Place Mansion was built in the 1760s for timber merchant and later MP John Cator, probably to designs associated with Stiff Leadbetter. The Palladian house crowns a broad park landscape; restored rooms now host exhibitions, studios, events and community uses.
places.descriptionIt: Beckenham Place Mansion fu costruita negli anni 1760 per il mercante di legname e futuro parlamentare John Cator, probabilmente su progetto legato a Stiff Leadbetter. La villa palladiana domina un vasto parco; le sale restaurate ospitano mostre, studi, eventi e attività comunitarie.

places.hook: A Palladian merchant’s mansion now anchors the renewed landscape of Beckenham Place Park.
places.hookIt: Una villa palladiana di un mercante è oggi il fulcro del paesaggio rinnovato di Beckenham Place Park.

places.name: Bell House
places.description: Bell House is a substantial Grade II-listed Georgian villa built in 1767 for stationer and later Lord Mayor Thomas Wright. Its symmetrical brick front, pedimented doorway, surviving interiors and walled garden recall Dulwich before suburban expansion; today a charity uses it for education and community events.
places.descriptionIt: Bell House è una grande villa georgiana di grado II costruita nel 1767 per il cartolaio e futuro Lord Mayor Thomas Wright. La facciata simmetrica in mattoni, il portale a frontone, gli interni e il giardino murato ricordano Dulwich prima dell’espansione suburbana; oggi ospita attività educative e comunitarie.

places.hook: A 1767 merchant’s villa preserves Georgian Dulwich behind walls and mature garden trees.
places.hookIt: Una villa mercantile del 1767 conserva la Dulwich georgiana dietro muri e alberi maturi.

places.name: Bollom House
places.description: This pin coincides with Bolton House at 14–16 Cullum Street; no separate historic ‘Bollom House’ is documented at the mapped position. The surviving building is the 1907 Art Nouveau office with blue-white faience, arched windows and a foliage frieze described in the adjoining Bolton House entry.
places.descriptionIt: Questo punto coincide con Bolton House ai numeri 14–16 di Cullum Street; nella posizione indicata non risulta documentato un edificio storico distinto chiamato “Bollom House”. L’edificio esistente è l’ufficio Art Nouveau del 1907 con maioliche bianche e blu, finestre ad arco e fregio vegetale descritto nella voce Bolton House.

places.hookIt: Il “Bollom House” della mappa è un duplicato errato del documentato Bolton House di Cullum Street.

places.name: Bolton House
places.description: Bolton House was completed in 1907 to designs by A. I. Selby, an unusually exuberant Art Nouveau survival in the commercial City. Blue, white and green faience frames tall arched windows, while foliage ornament and the heraldic device of Prior William Bolton animate its narrow Cullum Street façade.
places.descriptionIt: Bolton House fu completata nel 1907 su progetto di A. I. Selby ed è una rara e vivace testimonianza Art Nouveau nella City commerciale. Maioliche blu, bianche e verdi incorniciano alte finestre ad arco; motivi vegetali e lo stemma del priore William Bolton animano la stretta facciata su Cullum Street.
places.accessNotes: The exterior is visible from the public realm. The building itself is not a general visitor attraction; respect private entrances, residents and on-site security.
places.accessNotesIt: L’esterno è visibile dallo spazio pubblico. L’edificio non è un’attrazione aperta in generale: rispetta ingressi privati, residenti e controlli di sicurezza.
places.hook: Blue-green faience and a foliage frieze make this 1907 office a rare City Art Nouveau flourish.
places.hookIt: Maioliche blu-verdi e un fregio vegetale rendono questo ufficio del 1907 un raro guizzo Art Nouveau nella City.

places.name: Boston Manor House
places.description: Boston Manor House was completed in 1623 for Lady Mary Reade and later occupied for centuries by the Clitherow family. The Jacobean brick manor preserves an exceptional State Drawing Room with a richly modelled plaster ceiling, alongside restored domestic rooms that reveal how the house changed over four hundred years.
places.descriptionIt: Boston Manor House fu completata nel 1623 per Lady Mary Reade e fu poi abitata per secoli dalla famiglia Clitherow. La villa giacobiana in mattoni conserva un’eccezionale State Drawing Room con soffitto in stucco modellato e ambienti restaurati che mostrano quattro secoli di trasformazioni domestiche.

places.hook: A spectacular Jacobean plaster ceiling is the centrepiece of this restored 1623 manor house.
places.hookIt: Uno spettacolare soffitto giacobiano in stucco è il fulcro di questa villa restaurata del 1623.

places.name: Buckingham Palace
places.description: Buckingham House began as the Duke of Buckingham’s townhouse in 1703 and was acquired by George III in 1761. John Nash transformed it into a palace in the 1820s, Edward Blore completed the quadrangle, and the familiar east front and balcony were remodelled in the early twentieth century.
places.descriptionIt: Buckingham House nacque nel 1703 come residenza cittadina del duca di Buckingham e fu acquistata da Giorgio III nel 1761. John Nash la trasformò in palazzo negli anni 1820, Edward Blore completò il quadrilatero e l’attuale facciata est con balcone fu rielaborata all’inizio del Novecento.

places.hook: Behind the ceremonial balcony lies a palace assembled in stages from an early-eighteenth-century house.
places.hookIt: Dietro il balcone cerimoniale si trova un palazzo costruito per fasi attorno a una casa del primo Settecento.

places.name: Canonbury Tower
places.description: Canonbury Tower was built between about 1509 and 1532 as part of the country residence of the priors of St Bartholomew’s, Smithfield. The brick Tudor tower later housed figures including Francis Bacon and Oliver Goldsmith; its panelled rooms and rooftop views are normally seen only on arranged tours.
places.descriptionIt: Canonbury Tower fu costruita tra circa il 1509 e il 1532 come parte della residenza di campagna dei priori di St Bartholomew’s a Smithfield. La torre Tudor in mattoni ospitò poi personaggi come Francis Bacon e Oliver Goldsmith; sale rivestite in legno e panorama dal tetto si visitano normalmente solo su prenotazione.

places.accessNotesIt: È soprattutto un edificio operativo o privato, da osservare dallo spazio pubblico. Gli interni sono accessibili solo con autorizzazione o durante aperture occasionali.
places.hook: Islington’s Tudor tower links a medieval priory estate with residents including Bacon and Goldsmith.
places.hookIt: La torre Tudor di Islington collega un’antica proprietà priorale a residenti come Bacon e Goldsmith.

places.name: Carshalton Water Tower & Historic Garden Trust
places.description: Carshalton Water Tower was built in the early eighteenth century to supply Carshalton House and its formal gardens. The compact Baroque garden building combined a water-powered pump with an orangery, saloon and tiled plunge bath; surviving machinery and restored garden structures explain both engineering and leisure on the estate.
places.descriptionIt: La Carshalton Water Tower fu costruita all’inizio del Settecento per rifornire Carshalton House e i suoi giardini formali. Il piccolo edificio barocco riuniva pompa idraulica, aranciera, salone e vasca rivestita di piastrelle; macchinari e strutture restaurate raccontano ingegneria e svago della tenuta.

places.hook: A Baroque garden ornament ingeniously combined an orangery, plunge bath and water-pumping machinery.
places.hookIt: Un ornamento barocco da giardino riuniva ingegnosamente aranciera, vasca e macchinari per pompare l’acqua.

places.name: Central Hall Westminster
places.description: Central Hall Westminster was built in 1905–11 by Lanchester and Rickards as a monumental Methodist meeting place opposite Westminster Abbey. Its steel-framed domed auditorium hosted the first meeting of the United Nations General Assembly in 1946 and continues to serve worship, conferences and public events.
places.descriptionIt: Central Hall Westminster fu costruita nel 1905–11 da Lanchester e Rickards come monumentale sede metodista di fronte a Westminster Abbey. L’auditorium a cupola con struttura d’acciaio ospitò nel 1946 la prima riunione dell’Assemblea generale delle Nazioni Unite e continua ad accogliere culto, conferenze ed eventi.
places.accessNotes: Public access depends on the venue’s current opening hours, programme and security arrangements. Check the official site before travelling, especially for interiors or guided visits.
places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso dipende da orari, programma e controlli del luogo. Controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire, soprattutto per interni o visite guidate.
places.hook: A vast Methodist dome opposite the Abbey hosted the UN General Assembly’s first meeting in 1946.
places.hookIt: Una vasta cupola metodista di fronte all’Abbazia ospitò nel 1946 la prima Assemblea generale dell’ONU.

places.name: Clarence House
places.description: John Nash designed Clarence House in 1825–27 for the Duke of Clarence, the future William IV, beside St James’s Palace. Successive royal residents altered its restrained stucco interiors; it is now the London residence of King Charles III and Queen Camilla and opens only under limited seasonal arrangements.
places.descriptionIt: John Nash progettò Clarence House nel 1825–27 per il duca di Clarence, futuro Guglielmo IV, accanto a St James’s Palace. I successivi residenti reali modificarono i sobri interni in stucco; oggi è la residenza londinese di re Carlo III e della regina Camilla e apre solo in periodi limitati.
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: Nash’s restrained 1820s royal townhouse remains a working residence beside St James’s Palace.
places.hookIt: La sobria residenza reale degli anni 1820 progettata da Nash è ancora in uso accanto a St James’s Palace.

places.name: Danson House / Bexley Register Office
places.description: Sir Robert Taylor designed Danson House in the 1760s for sugar merchant Sir John Boyd, placing the compact Palladian villa above a landscaped lake. Rescued from severe decay and restored by English Heritage and Bexley, it retains an oval salon, decorative plasterwork and carefully reconstructed period colour schemes.
places.descriptionIt: Sir Robert Taylor progettò Danson House negli anni 1760 per il mercante di zucchero Sir John Boyd, collocando la compatta villa palladiana sopra un lago paesaggistico. Salvata dal degrado e restaurata da English Heritage e Bexley, conserva salone ovale, stucchi e colori d’epoca ricostruiti.

places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso dipende da orari, programma e controlli del luogo. Controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire, soprattutto per interni o visite guidate.
places.hook: A restored Palladian villa rises above Danson Park’s lake with an elegant oval salon at its heart.
places.hookIt: Una villa palladiana restaurata domina il lago di Danson Park con un elegante salone ovale al centro.

places.name: Debenham House
places.description: Halsey Ricardo designed Debenham House in 1905–07 for department-store owner Ernest Debenham. The Grade I Arts and Crafts house uses deep green and blue glazed bricks, Royal Doulton Carrara ware and William De Morgan mosaics to create one of London’s most richly coloured private façades.
places.descriptionIt: Halsey Ricardo progettò Debenham House nel 1905–07 per Ernest Debenham, proprietario dei grandi magazzini. La casa Arts and Crafts di grado I usa mattoni smaltati verde e blu, ceramica Carrara di Royal Doulton e mosaici di William De Morgan, creando una delle facciate private più colorate di Londra.
places.accessNotes: The exterior is visible from the public realm. The building itself is not a general visitor attraction; respect private entrances, residents and on-site security.

places.hook: Glazed blue-green brick and De Morgan mosaics turn this Arts and Crafts house into a ceramic jewel.
places.hookIt: Mattoni smaltati blu-verdi e mosaici di De Morgan trasformano questa casa Arts and Crafts in un gioiello ceramico.

places.name: Doulton House
places.description: The surviving Doulton building, now Southbank House, was completed in 1878 by Robert Stark Wilkinson as offices and a showroom for the Lambeth pottery. Red brick, buff and pink terracotta, a corner turret and George Tinworth reliefs made the façade a permanent catalogue of Doulton craftsmanship.
places.descriptionIt: L’edificio Doulton superstite, oggi Southbank House, fu completato nel 1878 da Robert Stark Wilkinson come uffici e showroom della ceramica di Lambeth. Mattoni rossi, terracotta rosa e color crema, una torretta angolare e rilievi di George Tinworth trasformarono la facciata in un catalogo permanente dell’abilità Doulton.
places.accessNotes: The exterior is visible from the public realm. The building itself is not a general visitor attraction; respect private entrances, residents and on-site security.
places.accessNotesIt: L’esterno è visibile dallo spazio pubblico. L’edificio non è un’attrazione aperta in generale: rispetta ingressi privati, residenti e controlli di sicurezza.
places.hook: Doulton used its own terracotta and sculpted reliefs to make this Victorian headquarters a full-scale showroom.
places.hookIt: Doulton usò la propria terracotta e rilievi scolpiti per trasformare la sede vittoriana in uno showroom a grandezza naturale.

places.name: Emirates Stadium
places.description: Emirates Stadium opened in 2006 as Arsenal Football Club’s new home, designed by HOK Sport, now Populous. Its four-tier bowl seats more than 60,000 spectators beneath a sweeping roof; the surrounding podium, bridges, statues and giant player graphics turn match-day circulation into a club history display.
places.descriptionIt: L’Emirates Stadium aprì nel 2006 come nuova casa dell’Arsenal, progettato da HOK Sport, oggi Populous. L’anello a quattro livelli accoglie oltre 60.000 spettatori sotto una copertura continua; podio, ponti, statue e grandi immagini dei giocatori trasformano il percorso dei tifosi in un racconto del club.
