places.hook: Arsenal’s four-tier bowl wraps more than 60,000 seats in a continuous roof and club-history podium.
places.hookIt: L’anello a quattro livelli dell’Arsenal racchiude oltre 60.000 posti sotto una copertura continua e un podio celebrativo.

places.name: Farm House
places.description: Farm House at 22 Farm Street is an early-twentieth-century rebuilding of a house whose site preserves the memory of Mayfair’s former Hay Hill Farm. Its theatrical half-timbered Gothic façade, leaded windows and reused Jacobean interior woodwork contrast sharply with the restrained stucco terraces around it.
places.descriptionIt: Farm House al 22 di Farm Street è una ricostruzione del primo Novecento di una casa il cui sito conserva il ricordo dell’antica Hay Hill Farm di Mayfair. La scenografica facciata gotica a graticcio, le finestre piombate e gli elementi lignei giacobiani riutilizzati contrastano con le sobrie case in stucco circostanti.
places.accessNotes: The exterior is visible from the public realm. The building itself is not a general visitor attraction; respect private entrances, residents and on-site security.
places.accessNotesIt: L’esterno è visibile dallo spazio pubblico. L’edificio non è un’attrazione aperta in generale: rispetta ingressi privati, residenti e controlli di sicurezza.
places.hook: A theatrical half-timbered farmhouse fantasy interrupts Mayfair’s orderly stucco terraces.
places.hookIt: Una fantasiosa casa rurale a graticcio interrompe l’ordine delle terrazze in stucco di Mayfair.

places.name: Forty Hall Estate
places.description: Forty Hall was built in 1629–32 for Sir Nicholas Rainton, a wealthy City haberdasher who became Lord Mayor of London. The symmetrical Jacobean house combines red brick, classical detail and a compact courtyard plan; its interiors and estate landscape trace the relationship between London wealth and the rural Lea valley.
places.descriptionIt: Forty Hall fu costruita nel 1629–32 per Sir Nicholas Rainton, ricco merciaio della City e futuro Lord Mayor. La simmetrica casa giacobiana combina mattoni rossi, dettagli classici e una corte compatta; interni e paesaggio della tenuta mostrano il legame tra ricchezza londinese e campagna della valle del Lea.

places.hook: A City merchant’s 1630s country house survives with its Jacobean courtyard and Lea-valley estate.
places.hookIt: La casa di campagna seicentesca di un mercante della City conserva corte giacobiana e tenuta nella valle del Lea.

places.name: Fulham Palace
places.description: Fulham Palace was the country residence of the bishops of London for more than twelve centuries, from around 704 until 1973. The surviving Tudor courtyard, Georgian rooms, chapel, museum and thirteen-acre botanical garden reveal repeated rebuilding as well as the bishops’ global plant collecting.
places.descriptionIt: Fulham Palace fu la residenza di campagna dei vescovi di Londra per oltre dodici secoli, dal circa 704 al 1973. La corte Tudor, le sale georgiane, la cappella, il museo e il giardino botanico di tredici acri raccontano continue ricostruzioni e la raccolta mondiale di piante dei vescovi.
places.accessNotes: Public access depends on the venue’s current opening hours, programme and security arrangements. Check the official site before travelling, especially for interiors or guided visits.

places.hook: A Tudor courtyard and botanical garden preserve twelve centuries of the bishops of London’s country estate.
places.hookIt: Una corte Tudor e un giardino botanico conservano dodici secoli della tenuta di campagna dei vescovi di Londra.

places.name: Garnault Place
places.description: This record marks one of the Victorian houses on Garnault Place rather than a separately named public monument. Stock brick, sash windows and modest classical dressings contribute to the small Clerkenwell square developed on the former New River Company estate beside New River Head and Sadler’s Wells.
places.descriptionIt: Questa voce indica una delle case vittoriane di Garnault Place, non un monumento pubblico con nome proprio. Mattoni gialli, finestre a ghigliottina e sobri dettagli classici contribuiscono alla piccola piazza di Clerkenwell sviluppata sull’antica proprietà della New River Company accanto a New River Head e Sadler’s Wells.
places.accessNotes: The exterior is visible from the public realm. The building itself is not a general visitor attraction; respect private entrances, residents and on-site security.
places.accessNotesIt: L’esterno è visibile dallo spazio pubblico. L’edificio non è un’attrazione aperta in generale: rispetta ingressi privati, residenti e controlli di sicurezza.
places.hook: A modest Victorian house gains meaning from Garnault Place’s compact New River Company estate setting.
places.hookIt: Una modesta casa vittoriana acquista significato nel raccolto contesto della proprietà della New River Company.

places.name: Gillette Building Studios
places.description: The Gillette factory opened on the Great West Road in 1937, designed by Sir Banister Fletcher’s practice as a landmark headquarters and manufacturing plant. Its symmetrical Art Deco frontage, long white colonnade, stepped clock tower and neon name advertised modern mass production to motorists on the ‘Golden Mile’.
places.descriptionIt: La fabbrica Gillette aprì sulla Great West Road nel 1937, progettata dallo studio di Sir Banister Fletcher come sede e stabilimento monumentale. La facciata Art Déco simmetrica, il lungo colonnato bianco, la torre dell’orologio a gradoni e il nome al neon pubblicizzavano la produzione moderna agli automobilisti del “Golden Mile”.
places.accessNotes: This is primarily a working or private building and is best appreciated from the public realm. Interior access is limited to authorised visits or occasional open days.
places.accessNotesIt: È soprattutto un edificio operativo o privato, da osservare dallo spazio pubblico. Gli interni sono accessibili solo con autorizzazione o durante aperture occasionali.
places.hook: A stepped clock tower and long white colonnade made Gillette’s factory the emblem of the Great West Road.
places.hookIt: Torre dell’orologio a gradoni e lungo colonnato bianco fecero della fabbrica Gillette l’emblema della Great West Road.

places.name: Granada Bingo Hall
places.description: The Granada Tooting opened in 1931, designed by Cecil Masey with spectacular interiors by theatre designer Theodore Komisarjevsky. Behind the restrained façade lies a fantasy of Gothic, Moorish and Spanish Baroque detail; the Grade I auditorium later became a bingo hall while retaining much of its original decoration.
places.descriptionIt: Il Granada Tooting aprì nel 1931, progettato da Cecil Masey con spettacolari interni dello scenografo Theodore Komisarjevsky. Dietro la facciata sobria si nasconde una fantasia gotica, moresca e barocca spagnola; l’auditorium di grado I divenne poi sala bingo conservando gran parte della decorazione originale.
places.accessNotes: Public access depends on the venue’s current opening hours, programme and security arrangements. Check the official site before travelling, especially for interiors or guided visits.
places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso dipende da orari, programma e controlli del luogo. Controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire, soprattutto per interni o visite guidate.
places.hook: Komisarjevsky’s fantastical Moorish-Gothic auditorium survives inside an otherwise restrained 1931 cinema.
places.hookIt: Il fantastico auditorium moresco-gotico di Komisarjevsky sopravvive dentro un cinema del 1931 dall’esterno sobrio.

places.name: Hall Place & Gardens
places.description: Hall Place began in 1537 as a Tudor mansion built for former Lord Mayor Sir John Champneys, using an eye-catching chequerboard of flint and stone. A seventeenth-century brick extension doubled the house; panelled rooms, a Great Hall, heraldic details and formal riverside gardens reveal its layered ownership.
places.descriptionIt: Hall Place nacque nel 1537 come villa Tudor per l’ex Lord Mayor Sir John Champneys, con un vistoso motivo a scacchiera di selce e pietra. Un ampliamento seicentesco in mattoni raddoppiò la casa; sale rivestite in legno, Great Hall, stemmi e giardini sul fiume raccontano i diversi proprietari.
places.accessNotes: Public access depends on the venue’s current opening hours, programme and security arrangements. Check the official site before travelling, especially for interiors or guided visits.
places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso dipende da orari, programma e controlli del luogo. Controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire, soprattutto per interni o visite guidate.
places.hook: Tudor flint-and-stone chequerwork meets a red-brick Jacobean extension beside the River Cray.
places.hookIt: La scacchiera Tudor di selce e pietra incontra un ampliamento giacobiano in mattoni rossi lungo il Cray.

places.name: Ham House and Garden
places.description: Ham House was built in 1610 for courtier Thomas Vavasour and transformed in the 1670s by the Duke and Duchess of Lauderdale. Its formal plan, richly furnished rooms, lacquer cabinets, textiles and gardens form an unusually complete record of elite Stuart taste and political ambition.
places.descriptionIt: Ham House fu costruita nel 1610 per il cortigiano Thomas Vavasour e trasformata negli anni 1670 dal duca e dalla duchessa di Lauderdale. Pianta formale, sale riccamente arredate, mobili laccati, tessuti e giardini offrono una testimonianza eccezionalmente completa del gusto e dell’ambizione politica degli Stuart.
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: Rich 1670s interiors and formal gardens make Ham House one of Britain’s most complete Stuart ensembles.
places.hookIt: Interni degli anni 1670 e giardini formali fanno di Ham House uno dei complessi Stuart più integri della Gran Bretagna.

places.name: Hampton Court Palace
places.description: Cardinal Wolsey began Hampton Court Palace around 1515 before Henry VIII took possession and expanded its Tudor courts, kitchens and Great Hall. William III and Mary II later commissioned Christopher Wren’s Baroque apartments; gardens, fountains and the famous maze preserve the palace’s competing royal visions.
places.descriptionIt: Il cardinale Wolsey iniziò Hampton Court Palace intorno al 1515; Enrico VIII ne prese possesso e ampliò corti Tudor, cucine e Great Hall. Guglielmo III e Maria II affidarono poi a Christopher Wren gli appartamenti barocchi; giardini, fontane e il celebre labirinto conservano visioni reali concorrenti.

places.hook: Henry VIII’s Tudor courts collide spectacularly with Wren’s Baroque palace and formal gardens.
places.hookIt: Le corti Tudor di Enrico VIII incontrano in modo spettacolare il palazzo barocco di Wren e i giardini formali.

places.name: Harmondsworth Barn
places.description: Harmondsworth Great Barn was erected in 1425–27 by Winchester College to store grain from its manor. Twelve timber bays, huge aisle posts and an intact medieval roof create the scale that led John Betjeman to call it the ‘Cathedral of Middlesex’; it is among England’s finest surviving medieval barns.
places.descriptionIt: Il Great Barn di Harmondsworth fu eretto nel 1425–27 dal Winchester College per conservare il grano della tenuta. Dodici campate lignee, enormi pilastri e il tetto medievale integro creano la scala che spinse John Betjeman a chiamarlo “Cattedrale del Middlesex”; è tra i migliori granai medievali inglesi.

places.hook: Twelve vast timber bays justify this fifteenth-century grain barn’s nickname, the ‘Cathedral of Middlesex’.
places.hookIt: Dodici immense campate lignee giustificano il soprannome di questo granaio quattrocentesco: “Cattedrale del Middlesex”.

places.name: Harrow School Chapel
places.description: George Gilbert Scott designed Harrow School Chapel, completed in 1855, in a muscular Gothic Revival style suited to its hilltop setting. Flint and stone, a prominent bell turret, stained glass and memorial fittings make it both the school’s place of worship and a record of generations of pupils.
places.descriptionIt: George Gilbert Scott progettò la cappella della Harrow School, completata nel 1855, in un deciso stile neogotico adatto alla posizione sulla collina. Selce e pietra, torre campanaria, vetrate e monumenti la rendono luogo di culto e memoria di generazioni di studenti.

places.hook: Scott’s flint-and-stone chapel gives Harrow’s hilltop campus its emphatic Victorian Gothic landmark.
places.hookIt: La cappella in selce e pietra di Scott dà al campus collinare di Harrow il suo deciso punto di riferimento neogotico.

places.name: Harrow School Old Speech Room Gallery
places.description: The Old Speech Room was built in 1819–21 so Harrow pupils could practise public speaking before an audience. Now a gallery, it displays the school’s collections of antiquities, art, natural history, rare books and material connected with former pupils including Byron, Churchill and Cecil Beaton.
places.descriptionIt: L’Old Speech Room fu costruita nel 1819–21 affinché gli studenti di Harrow potessero esercitarsi a parlare in pubblico. Oggi galleria, espone antichità, arte, storia naturale, libri rari e materiali legati ad ex allievi come Byron, Churchill e Cecil Beaton.

places.hook: A purpose-built 1820s speaking chamber now holds Harrow’s unusually wide teaching and alumni collections.
places.hookIt: Una sala degli anni 1820 nata per l’oratoria ospita oggi le ampie collezioni didattiche e storiche di Harrow.

places.name: Hornsey Town Hall Arts Centre
places.description: Reginald Uren’s Grade II* modernist town hall opened in 1935 and has been restored as a Crouch End arts, events and workspace complex while retaining its civic rooms and limestone geometry.
places.descriptionIt: Il municipio modernista Grade II* di Reginald Uren, inaugurato nel 1935, è stato restaurato come centro per arti, eventi e lavoro a Crouch End, conservando sale civiche e geometrie in pietra.

places.hookIt: Il municipio modernista Grade II* di Reginald Uren, inaugurato nel 1935, è stato restaurato come centro per arti, eventi e lavoro a Crouch End, conservando sale civiche e geometrie in pietra.

places.name: Ironmongers' Hall
places.description: Ironmongers’ Hall was completed in 1925 by Sydney Tatchell for one of the City’s medieval livery companies. Its restrained Tudor Revival exterior gives way to oak panelling, heraldic glass, carved screens and historic portraits; remarkably, it survived the surrounding destruction of the Second World War.
places.descriptionIt: Ironmongers’ Hall fu completata nel 1925 da Sydney Tatchell per una delle antiche corporazioni della City. L’esterno neotudor sobrio introduce pannelli di quercia, vetrate araldiche, schermi intagliati e ritratti storici; sopravvisse sorprendentemente alle distruzioni belliche circostanti.

places.accessNotesIt: È soprattutto un edificio operativo o privato, da osservare dallo spazio pubblico. Gli interni sono accessibili solo con autorizzazione o durante aperture occasionali.
places.hook: A 1920s Tudor Revival hall preserves the Ironmongers’ heraldry and collections amid the rebuilt Barbican district.
places.hookIt: Una sede neotudor degli anni Venti conserva araldica e collezioni degli Ironmongers nel quartiere ricostruito del Barbican.

places.name: Kenwood House
places.description: Robert Adam remodelled Kenwood House in the 1760s and 1770s for Lord Chief Justice Mansfield, adding its celebrated white-stucco library and north front. The free collection assembled by Edward Guinness, Earl of Iveagh, includes Rembrandt, Vermeer, Gainsborough and Reynolds within landscaped Hampstead Heath.
places.descriptionIt: Robert Adam rinnovò Kenwood House negli anni 1760 e 1770 per il Lord Chief Justice Mansfield, aggiungendo la celebre biblioteca in stucco bianco e il fronte nord. La collezione gratuita di Edward Guinness, conte di Iveagh, comprende Rembrandt, Vermeer, Gainsborough e Reynolds nel paesaggio di Hampstead Heath.

places.hook: Adam’s luminous neoclassical library frames an exceptional free art collection on Hampstead Heath.
places.hookIt: La luminosa biblioteca neoclassica di Adam accoglie un’eccezionale collezione d’arte gratuita a Hampstead Heath.

places.name: London Scottish House
places.description: London Scottish House opened in 1886 as the drill hall and headquarters of the London Scottish Regiment. The red-brick building combines military utility with battlements, memorials and regimental emblems; its hall and rooms continue as an events venue while maintaining links to the regiment and its museum collection.
places.descriptionIt: London Scottish House aprì nel 1886 come sala d’addestramento e quartier generale del London Scottish Regiment. L’edificio in mattoni rossi unisce funzione militare, merli, monumenti ed emblemi; sala e ambienti sono oggi sede di eventi mantenendo il legame con il reggimento e il suo museo.

places.hook: A castellated Victorian drill hall keeps the London Scottish Regiment’s identity visible in Westminster.
places.hookIt: Una sala d’addestramento vittoriana merlata mantiene visibile a Westminster l’identità del London Scottish Regiment.

places.name: Metropolitan Police Marine Policing Unit
places.description: Wapping Police Station stands on the Thames site used by the Marine Police since 1798, making it the historic base of one of the world’s earliest organised preventive police forces. The present riverside station dates largely from 1907 and remains the operational home of the Metropolitan Police Marine Policing Unit.
places.descriptionIt: La stazione di polizia di Wapping occupa il sito sul Tamigi usato dalla Marine Police dal 1798, base storica di una delle prime forze di polizia preventiva organizzata al mondo. L’attuale edificio fluviale risale in gran parte al 1907 ed è ancora la sede operativa della Marine Policing Unit.
places.accessNotes: This is primarily a working or private building and is best appreciated from the public realm. Interior access is limited to authorised visits or occasional open days.
places.accessNotesIt: È soprattutto un edificio operativo o privato, da osservare dallo spazio pubblico. Gli interni sono accessibili solo con autorizzazione o durante aperture occasionali.
places.hook: London’s river police have worked from this Wapping site since 1798; the current station remains operational.
places.hookIt: La polizia fluviale di Londra opera da questo sito di Wapping dal 1798; la stazione è tuttora in servizio.

places.name: Michelin House
places.description: Michelin House was completed in 1911 by François Espinasse as the tyre company’s British headquarters, depot and fitting station. Its colourful tiled panels depict early motoring scenes and the Bibendum mascot, while stained-glass windows and curved corner turrets turn commercial branding into exuberant architecture.
places.descriptionIt: Michelin House fu completata nel 1911 da François Espinasse come sede britannica, deposito e officina della casa di pneumatici. Pannelli di maiolica raffigurano scene automobilistiche e la mascotte Bibendum; vetrate e torrette curve trasformano il marchio commerciale in architettura esuberante.

places.hook: Bibendum stained glass and motoring tiles make Michelin’s 1911 headquarters an early masterpiece of brand architecture.
places.hookIt: Vetrate di Bibendum e piastrelle automobilistiche fanno della sede Michelin del 1911 un capolavoro precoce di architettura del marchio.

places.name: Montcalm East
places.description: Squire & Partners designed Montcalm East, completed in 2015, as an optical landmark opposite Moorfields Eye Hospital. A faceted, diamond-like form and irregular diagonal windows make the façade appear to shift with viewpoint, while its lower skin lifts to reveal the hotel lobby, restaurant and public activity.
places.descriptionIt: Squire & Partners progettò Montcalm East, completato nel 2015, come landmark ottico di fronte al Moorfields Eye Hospital. La forma sfaccettata a diamante e le finestre diagonali irregolari fanno cambiare la facciata con il punto di vista, mentre il rivestimento inferiore si solleva rivelando hall e ristorante.

places.hook: Diagonal windows turn a Shoreditch hotel into an optical illusion opposite Moorfields Eye Hospital.
places.hookIt: Finestre diagonali trasformano un hotel di Shoreditch in un’illusione ottica di fronte al Moorfields Eye Hospital.

places.name: National Trust - Fenton House and Garden
places.description: Fenton House is a late-seventeenth-century merchant’s house on Hampstead’s highest ground, acquired for the National Trust with the collection of Major Benton Fletcher. Panelled rooms contain early keyboard instruments, porcelain and needlework, while a walled garden preserves orchard, kitchen beds and formal planting.
places.descriptionIt: Fenton House è una casa mercantile del tardo Seicento sul punto più alto di Hampstead, acquisita dal National Trust con la collezione del maggiore Benton Fletcher. Sale rivestite in legno ospitano antichi strumenti a tastiera, porcellane e ricami; il giardino murato conserva frutteto, orto e aiuole formali.

places.hook: Early keyboards fill a seventeenth-century merchant’s house above a walled Hampstead orchard.
places.hookIt: Antichi strumenti a tastiera riempiono una casa mercantile seicentesca sopra un frutteto murato di Hampstead.

places.name: National Trust - Red House
places.description: Philip Webb designed Red House in 1859 for William and Jane Morris as a home shaped around art, craft and communal making. Red brick, steep roofs and an informal L-plan reject Victorian symmetry; furniture, stained glass and painted decoration by Morris’s circle helped seed the Arts and Crafts movement.
places.descriptionIt: Philip Webb progettò Red House nel 1859 per William e Jane Morris come casa fondata su arte, artigianato e lavoro condiviso. Mattoni rossi, tetti ripidi e pianta a L rifiutano la simmetria vittoriana; mobili, vetrate e decorazioni del circolo di Morris contribuirono alla nascita dell’Arts and Crafts.
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: Morris and Webb turned a red-brick family home into a manifesto for the Arts and Crafts movement.
places.hookIt: Morris e Webb trasformarono una casa familiare in mattoni rossi in un manifesto del movimento Arts and Crafts.

places.name: National Trust - Sutton House and Breaker's Yard
places.description: Sutton House was built in 1535 for Ralph Sadleir, a leading courtier of Henry VIII, and is the oldest surviving domestic building in Hackney. Its brick Tudor ranges contain an oak-panelled parlour, carved fireplace and courtyard, alongside later Georgian alterations and traces of its twentieth-century squatters.
places.descriptionIt: Sutton House fu costruita nel 1535 per Ralph Sadleir, importante cortigiano di Enrico VIII, ed è il più antico edificio domestico superstite di Hackney. Le ali Tudor in mattoni conservano salotto in quercia, camino scolpito e corte, accanto ad aggiunte georgiane e tracce degli occupanti abusivi novecenteschi.

places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: Hackney’s oldest house layers a Tudor courtier’s brick home with Georgian rooms and squatter history.
places.hookIt: La casa più antica di Hackney sovrappone la dimora Tudor di un cortigiano, sale georgiane e storia degli squatters.

places.name: Netil House
places.description: Netil House is a former mid-twentieth-century council and educational building recast as a workspace for Hackney’s independent creative businesses. Its robust concrete frame now contains studios, workshops, food and music venues, while the rooftop looks across London Fields and the railway arches.
places.descriptionIt: Netil House è un ex edificio civico e scolastico del Novecento trasformato in spazio di lavoro per attività creative indipendenti di Hackney. La robusta struttura in cemento ospita studi, laboratori, ristorazione e musica; dal tetto si guarda verso London Fields e gli archi ferroviari.

places.hook: A utilitarian concrete block has become a dense vertical neighbourhood of Hackney studios and venues.
places.hookIt: Un blocco utilitario in cemento è diventato un fitto quartiere verticale di studi e locali di Hackney.

places.name: Palace of Westminster
places.description: Charles Barry and A. W. N. Pugin rebuilt the Palace of Westminster after the fire of 1834, combining a rational parliamentary plan with intensely detailed Gothic Revival decoration. River terraces, courtyards, the hammer-beam Westminster Hall and the Elizabeth Tower form a working legislature layered over a medieval royal site.
places.descriptionIt: Charles Barry e A. W. N. Pugin ricostruirono il Palace of Westminster dopo l’incendio del 1834, unendo una pianta parlamentare razionale a una ricchissima decorazione neogotica. Terrazze sul fiume, corti, Westminster Hall e Elizabeth Tower formano un parlamento attivo su un sito reale medievale.
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: Barry’s disciplined plan and Pugin’s Gothic detail created the world’s most recognisable parliamentary complex.
places.hookIt: La pianta disciplinata di Barry e i dettagli gotici di Pugin crearono il complesso parlamentare più riconoscibile al mondo.

places.name: Queens ex cinema art deco
places.description: The former Queens Cinema opened on Bishop’s Bridge Road in 1932 with a streamlined Art Deco façade. After the cinema closed in 1988, a 2014 redevelopment by Stiff + Trevillion retained and restored the curved landmark frontage, placing shops and new apartments behind its cream ceramic skin.
places.descriptionIt: L’ex Queens Cinema aprì su Bishop’s Bridge Road nel 1932 con una facciata Art Déco aerodinamica. Dopo la chiusura nel 1988, il progetto del 2014 di Stiff + Trevillion conservò e restaurò il fronte curvo, inserendo negozi e nuovi appartamenti dietro il rivestimento ceramico color crema.
places.accessNotes: The exterior is visible from the public realm. The building itself is not a general visitor attraction; respect private entrances, residents and on-site security.
places.accessNotesIt: L’esterno è visibile dallo spazio pubblico. L’edificio non è un’attrazione aperta in generale: rispetta ingressi privati, residenti e controlli di sicurezza.
places.hook: A restored 1932 cinema façade now curves around shops and apartments at the edge of Bayswater.
places.hookIt: Una facciata cinematografica del 1932 restaurata avvolge oggi negozi e appartamenti ai margini di Bayswater.

places.name: Rio Cinema
places.description: The Rio traces its cinema use to 1909; the present auditorium and bold blue frontage were remodelled in 1937 by F. E. Bromige in an exuberant Art Deco style. Curving bands, a vertical fin and neon announce one of London’s longest-running independent cinemas, still screening repertory and new releases.
places.descriptionIt: Il Rio ospita proiezioni dal 1909; l’attuale sala e la vivace facciata blu furono ridisegnate nel 1937 da F. E. Bromige in esuberante stile Art Déco. Fasce curve, pinna verticale e neon annunciano uno dei cinema indipendenti più longevi di Londra, ancora attivo con film nuovi e di repertorio.
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: Bromige’s blue, neon-lit 1937 façade still announces a fiercely independent Dalston cinema.
places.hookIt: La facciata blu al neon progettata da Bromige nel 1937 annuncia ancora un cinema fieramente indipendente di Dalston.

places.name: Royal Albert Hall
places.description: The Royal Albert Hall opened in 1871 as part of Prince Albert’s vision for a district devoted to arts and science. Designed by Francis Fowke and Henry Y. D. Scott, its vast elliptical brick-and-terracotta drum carries a mosaic frieze; the famous suspended acoustic diffusers tame the domed auditorium’s echo.
places.descriptionIt: La Royal Albert Hall aprì nel 1871 come parte della visione del principe Alberto per un quartiere dedicato ad arti e scienze. Progettata da Francis Fowke e Henry Y. D. Scott, la vasta ellisse in mattoni e terracotta porta un fregio musivo; i celebri diffusori sospesi correggono l’eco della cupola.
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: A terracotta ellipse, mosaic frieze and airborne acoustic ‘mushrooms’ define Britain’s great circular concert hall.
places.hookIt: Un’ellisse in terracotta, un fregio musivo e i “funghi” acustici sospesi definiscono la grande sala da concerto circolare britannica.

places.name: Royal Courts of Justice
places.description: George Edmund Street designed the Royal Courts of Justice, opened in 1882, as a vast Gothic Revival complex for the senior civil courts. A soaring stone Great Hall acts as its internal street, feeding an intricate network of courts, corridors, staircases and courtyards behind the Strand’s pinnacled façade.
places.descriptionIt: George Edmund Street progettò le Royal Courts of Justice, aperte nel 1882, come vasto complesso neogotico per le corti civili superiori. La grande hall in pietra funge da strada interna, distribuendo un intricato sistema di aule, corridoi, scale e corti dietro la facciata a pinnacoli sullo Strand.
places.accessNotes: This is primarily a working or private building and is best appreciated from the public realm. Interior access is limited to authorised visits or occasional open days.
places.accessNotesIt: È soprattutto un edificio operativo o privato, da osservare dallo spazio pubblico. Gli interni sono accessibili solo con autorizzazione o durante aperture occasionali.
places.hook: Street’s soaring Great Hall forms the internal avenue of London’s labyrinthine Gothic law courts.
places.hookIt: La svettante Great Hall di Street forma il viale interno del labirintico palazzo di giustizia neogotico londinese.

places.name: Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia
places.description: The Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia occupies a purpose-built reconstruction of Nos. 30–32 Charles Street. The earlier Georgian terrace was replaced with a larger diplomatic complex whose carefully proportioned brick-and-stucco façade reproduces the rhythm of neighbouring Mayfair houses while concealing modern secure accommodation.
places.descriptionIt: La Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia occupa una ricostruzione appositamente realizzata dei numeri 30–32 di Charles Street. La precedente terrazza georgiana fu sostituita da un complesso diplomatico più grande, la cui facciata in mattoni e stucco riprende il ritmo delle case di Mayfair nascondendo spazi moderni e protetti.
places.accessNotes: This is primarily a working or private building and is best appreciated from the public realm. Interior access is limited to authorised visits or occasional open days.
places.accessNotesIt: È soprattutto un edificio operativo o privato, da osservare dallo spazio pubblico. Gli interni sono accessibili solo con autorizzazione o durante aperture occasionali.
places.hook: A modern secure embassy disguises its larger scale behind a carefully reconstructed Georgian Mayfair terrace.
places.hookIt: Una moderna ambasciata protetta nasconde la scala maggiore dietro una terrazza georgiana di Mayfair accuratamente ricostruita.

places.name: Royal Opera House - Floral Hall
places.description: Edward Middleton Barry designed the Royal Opera House’s Floral Hall in 1858–60 as a glass-and-iron winter garden and flower market, inspired by the Crystal Palace. Restored and incorporated into the opera house redevelopment, its slender columns, sweeping stair and glazed barrel roof now form the public Paul Hamlyn Hall.
places.descriptionIt: Edward Middleton Barry progettò il Floral Hall della Royal Opera House nel 1858–60 come giardino d’inverno e mercato dei fiori in vetro e ferro, ispirato al Crystal Palace. Restaurato e integrato nel teatro, con colonne sottili, grande scala e volta vetrata, è oggi la Paul Hamlyn Hall aperta al pubblico.

places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso dipende da orari, programma e controlli del luogo. Controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire, soprattutto per interni o visite guidate.
places.hook: A Crystal Palace-inspired flower market survives as the Royal Opera House’s luminous public foyer.
places.hookIt: Un mercato dei fiori ispirato al Crystal Palace sopravvive come luminoso foyer pubblico della Royal Opera House.

places.name: Royal Victoria Patriotic Building
places.description: The Royal Victoria Patriotic Building was constructed in 1857–59 by Rohde Hawkins as a school for daughters orphaned during the Crimean War. Its long, turreted Gothic Revival frontage later served military and hospital uses; restored after years of dereliction, it now contains studios, homes and hospitality spaces.
places.descriptionIt: Il Royal Victoria Patriotic Building fu costruito nel 1857–59 da Rohde Hawkins come scuola per le figlie rimaste orfane durante la guerra di Crimea. La lunga facciata neogotica con torrette ebbe poi usi militari e ospedalieri; restaurata dopo anni di abbandono, ospita studi, abitazioni e locali.

places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso dipende da orari, programma e controlli del luogo. Controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire, soprattutto per interni o visite guidate.
places.hook: A turreted Crimean War orphan school has become a many-layered creative enclave on Wandsworth Common.
places.hookIt: Una scuola merlata per orfane della guerra di Crimea è diventata un complesso creativo stratificato a Wandsworth Common.

places.name: Severndroog Castle
places.description: Architect Richard Jupp built Severndroog Castle in 1784 for Lady James as a memorial to her husband, Commodore Sir William James, whose naval victory at Suvarnadurg inspired its name. The triangular Gothic tower crowns Shooter’s Hill; restored rooms and a roof platform give long views across London and Kent.
places.descriptionIt: L’architetto Richard Jupp costruì Severndroog Castle nel 1784 per Lady James in memoria del marito, il commodoro Sir William James, la cui vittoria navale a Suvarnadurg ispirò il nome. La torre gotica triangolare corona Shooter’s Hill; sale restaurate e terrazza offrono ampie vedute su Londra e Kent.

places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: A triangular Georgian memorial tower turns a naval victory into one of south-east London’s best viewpoints.
places.hookIt: Una torre commemorativa georgiana triangolare trasforma una vittoria navale in uno dei migliori belvedere del sud-est di Londra.

places.name: Shakespeare's Globe
places.description: Shakespeare’s Globe opened in 1997 after actor-director Sam Wanamaker’s campaign to recreate the open-air playhouse near its original Bankside site. Architect Theo Crosby and historical craftsmen used green oak, lime plaster and a thatched roof to reinterpret Elizabethan building methods for a modern working theatre.
places.descriptionIt: Shakespeare’s Globe aprì nel 1997 dopo la campagna dell’attore e regista Sam Wanamaker per ricreare il teatro all’aperto vicino al sito originale di Bankside. Theo Crosby e artigiani specializzati usarono quercia verde, intonaco di calce e tetto di paglia per reinterpretare tecniche elisabettiane in un teatro moderno.

places.hook: Green oak, lime plaster and thatch make this modern theatre a working experiment in Elizabethan construction.
places.hookIt: Quercia verde, calce e paglia fanno di questo teatro moderno un esperimento vivo di costruzione elisabettiana.

places.name: Spencer House
places.description: Spencer House was built from 1756 for the first Earl Spencer, with John Vardy designing the Palladian exterior and James ‘Athenian’ Stuart creating pioneering neoclassical interiors. Restored state rooms overlook Green Park and preserve one of London’s finest surviving eighteenth-century aristocratic townhouses.
places.descriptionIt: Spencer House fu costruita dal 1756 per il primo conte Spencer: John Vardy progettò l’esterno palladiano e James “Athenian” Stuart i pionieristici interni neoclassici. Le sale di rappresentanza restaurate affacciano su Green Park e conservano una delle migliori residenze aristocratiche settecentesche di Londra.
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: Palladian restraint outside gives way to some of London’s earliest and richest neoclassical rooms.
places.hookIt: La sobrietà palladiana esterna lascia il posto ad alcuni dei primi e più ricchi interni neoclassici di Londra.

places.name: St Bartholomew's North Wing
places.description: James Gibbs designed St Bartholomew’s Hospital’s North Wing in the 1730s around a grand staircase and Great Hall. William Hogarth donated the vast biblical paintings on the stair walls, while portraits, plasterwork and archives connect the architecture to the hospital’s history since its foundation in 1123.
places.descriptionIt: James Gibbs progettò la North Wing del St Bartholomew’s Hospital negli anni 1730 attorno a una grande scala e alla Great Hall. William Hogarth donò gli enormi dipinti biblici sulle pareti; ritratti, stucchi e archivi collegano l’architettura alla storia dell’ospedale fondato nel 1123.

places.hook: Hogarth’s monumental paintings climb the staircase of Gibbs’s eighteenth-century hospital wing.
places.hookIt: I monumentali dipinti di Hogarth salgono lungo la scala dell’ala ospedaliera settecentesca di Gibbs.

places.name: St James’s Palace
places.description: Henry VIII’s red-brick Tudor palace remains a working royal residence and the formal seat of the Court of St James’s; visitors mainly see its gatehouse and Chapel Royal exterior from the public street.
places.descriptionIt: Il palazzo Tudor in mattoni rossi di Enrico VIII resta una residenza reale attiva e la sede formale della Court of St James’s; dalla strada si osservano soprattutto il portale e l’esterno della Chapel Royal.

places.name: St John's Gate
places.description: St John’s Gate was built in 1504 as the south entrance to the medieval priory of the Knights of St John. The crenellated stone gateway later housed a tavern, the Gentleman’s Magazine and antiquarian collections; today its rooms form part of the Museum of the Order of St John.
places.descriptionIt: St John’s Gate fu costruita nel 1504 come ingresso meridionale al priorato medievale dei Cavalieri di San Giovanni. La porta merlata in pietra ospitò poi una taverna, il Gentleman’s Magazine e collezioni antiquarie; oggi le sale fanno parte del Museum of the Order of St John.

places.hook: A 1504 priory gate has served as tavern, printing address and museum of the Order of St John.
places.hookIt: Una porta priorale del 1504 è stata taverna, sede editoriale e museo dell’Ordine di San Giovanni.

places.name: St Olaf House
places.description: This Grade II* 1931 headquarters for Hay’s Wharf combines Portland stone, polished granite and river-facing sculptural panels, while a St Olaf figure recalls the medieval church formerly on the site.
places.descriptionIt: Questa sede Grade II* del 1931 per Hay’s Wharf unisce pietra di Portland, granito lucido e pannelli scultorei sul fiume; una figura di sant’Olaf ricorda la chiesa medievale un tempo presente sul sito.

places.name: St Pancras International
places.description: St Pancras combines William Henry Barlow’s vast 1868 iron-and-glass train shed with George Gilbert Scott’s 1873 Midland Grand Hotel, a polychrome Gothic Revival landmark. Saved from demolition and restored for Eurostar in 2007, the complex makes Victorian railway engineering inseparable from theatrical urban architecture.
places.descriptionIt: St Pancras unisce l’immensa tettoia ferroviaria in ferro e vetro di William Henry Barlow del 1868 al Midland Grand Hotel neogotico policromo di George Gilbert Scott del 1873. Salvato dalla demolizione e restaurato per Eurostar nel 2007, lega ingegneria ferroviaria vittoriana e architettura urbana teatrale.

places.hook: Barlow’s record-breaking train shed meets Scott’s exuberant Gothic hotel in a rescued Victorian landmark.
places.hookIt: La tettoia da record di Barlow incontra l’esuberante hotel gotico di Scott in un monumento vittoriano salvato.

places.name: Strawberry Hill House & Garden
places.description: Horace Walpole transformed Strawberry Hill between 1749 and 1776 into a deliberately theatrical ‘little Gothic castle’. Drawing on medieval tombs, chapels and fan vaults rather than archaeological consistency, its white towers, coloured glass and gilded interiors helped launch the Gothic Revival and the Gothic novel.
places.descriptionIt: Horace Walpole trasformò Strawberry Hill tra il 1749 e il 1776 in un teatrale “piccolo castello gotico”. Ispirandosi a tombe, cappelle e volte medievali senza rigore archeologico, torri bianche, vetri colorati e interni dorati contribuirono a lanciare il Gothic Revival e il romanzo gotico.

places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: Walpole’s playful white castle turned fragments of imagined medieval design into the Gothic Revival.
places.hookIt: Il giocoso castello bianco di Walpole trasformò frammenti di Medioevo immaginato nel Gothic Revival.

places.name: Streatham Common Pumping Station
places.description: The 1894 waterworks disguises heavy engineering behind an extraordinary composition of brick, stone, glazed drums and Moorish-style copper domes, now connected to London’s ring-main system.
places.descriptionIt: L’impianto idrico del 1894 nasconde l’ingegneria pesante dietro una composizione straordinaria di mattoni, pietra, tamburi vetrati e cupole in rame di gusto moresco, oggi collegata al ring main londinese.

places.name: Syon House
places.description: Syon House has been the London seat of the Dukes of Northumberland since the sixteenth century. Robert Adam remodelled its principal interiors in the 1760s as a sequence of dazzling neoclassical rooms, while Capability Brown shaped the surrounding park beside the Thames and the later conservatory added a glass landmark.
places.descriptionIt: Syon House è la residenza londinese dei duchi di Northumberland dal Cinquecento. Robert Adam ridisegnò gli ambienti principali negli anni 1760 come spettacolare sequenza neoclassica; Capability Brown modellò il parco lungo il Tamigi e la successiva serra aggiunse un landmark in vetro.
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: Adam’s procession of neoclassical rooms opens toward Capability Brown’s Thames-side park.
places.hookIt: La sequenza di sale neoclassiche di Adam si apre sul parco lungo il Tamigi di Capability Brown.

places.name: The Ancient House
places.description: The Ancient House is a timber-framed hall house built around 1435, when Walthamstow was still a small Essex village. Now divided into homes, its jettied upper storey, exposed beams and irregular plaster panels preserve a rare medieval domestic form opposite St Mary’s churchyard.
places.descriptionIt: The Ancient House è una casa a sala con struttura lignea costruita intorno al 1435, quando Walthamstow era ancora un piccolo villaggio dell’Essex. Oggi divisa in abitazioni, conserva piano superiore aggettante, travi e pannelli d’intonaco irregolari, rara forma domestica medievale di fronte a St Mary’s.
places.accessNotes: The exterior is visible from the public realm. The building itself is not a general visitor attraction; respect private entrances, residents and on-site security.
places.accessNotesIt: L’esterno è visibile dallo spazio pubblico. L’edificio non è un’attrazione aperta in generale: rispetta ingressi privati, residenti e controlli di sicurezza.
places.hook: A jettied timber hall house from about 1435 survives at the heart of Walthamstow Village.
places.hookIt: Una casa a sala lignea aggettante del 1435 circa sopravvive nel cuore di Walthamstow Village.

places.name: The Cosmic House
places.description: Architectural theorist Charles Jencks transformed his Holland Park home with Terry Farrell between 1978 and 1983 into a manifesto of Postmodern design. Rooms, stairs, furniture and garden encode cosmology, time and the seasons through colour, geometry and symbolic ornament, making the house itself an inhabited argument.
places.descriptionIt: Il teorico dell’architettura Charles Jencks trasformò la propria casa di Holland Park con Terry Farrell tra il 1978 e il 1983 in un manifesto postmoderno. Stanze, scale, mobili e giardino codificano cosmologia, tempo e stagioni tramite colore, geometria e simboli, facendo della casa un’argomentazione abitata.

places.hook: Jencks made cosmology inhabitable, turning every stair, room and motif into Postmodern argument.
places.hookIt: Jencks rese abitabile la cosmologia, trasformando ogni scala, stanza e motivo in un’argomentazione postmoderna.

places.name: The Old Vic
places.description: The Old Vic opened in 1818 as the Royal Coburg Theatre and gained its present name after becoming the Royal Victoria. Its long history ranges from music hall and temperance lectures to Lilian Baylis’s influential Shakespeare and opera seasons; the compact auditorium remains one of London’s defining producing theatres.
places.descriptionIt: The Old Vic aprì nel 1818 come Royal Coburg Theatre e assunse il nome attuale dopo essere diventato Royal Victoria. La storia va dal music hall e dalle conferenze sulla temperanza alle influenti stagioni shakespeariane e liriche di Lilian Baylis; la sala raccolta resta uno dei principali teatri di produzione londinesi.
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: An 1818 theatre survived music hall, temperance and wartime damage to become a cornerstone of London drama.
places.hookIt: Un teatro del 1818 ha attraversato music hall, temperanza e danni bellici diventando un pilastro della scena londinese.

places.name: Tower Bridge
places.description: Tower Bridge was built in 1886–94 by engineer John Wolfe Barry to a Gothic design by Horace Jones, allowing road traffic to cross without blocking busy Pool of London shipping. Twin bascules still lift between stone-clad towers; high-level walkways and preserved engine rooms explain the original steam-hydraulic machinery.
places.descriptionIt: Tower Bridge fu costruito nel 1886–94 dall’ingegnere John Wolfe Barry su disegno gotico di Horace Jones, permettendo al traffico stradale di attraversare senza bloccare le navi del Pool of London. Le due bascule si sollevano ancora tra torri rivestite in pietra; passerelle e sale macchine illustrano il sistema idraulico a vapore originale.
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: Gothic stone towers disguise the steelwork and moving bascules of a brilliantly practical Victorian bridge.
places.hookIt: Torri gotiche in pietra nascondono acciaio e bascule mobili di un ponte vittoriano brillantemente pratico.

places.name: Tower of London
places.description: William the Conqueror began the Tower of London in the 1070s, with the massive White Tower asserting Norman power over the city. Successive monarchs expanded it as fortress, palace, prison, armoury and mint; walls, towers, chapel, ravens and Crown Jewels embody nearly a millennium of contested royal history.
places.descriptionIt: Guglielmo il Conquistatore iniziò la Tower of London negli anni 1070, con la massiccia White Tower a imporre il potere normanno sulla città. I sovrani successivi la ampliarono come fortezza, palazzo, prigione, arsenale e zecca; mura, torri, cappella, corvi e Gioielli della Corona incarnano quasi mille anni di storia reale contesa.
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: The Norman White Tower anchors a fortress repeatedly adapted as palace, prison, armoury and treasury.
places.hookIt: La White Tower normanna è il fulcro di una fortezza trasformata in palazzo, prigione, arsenale e tesoro.

places.name: Trellick Tower
places.description: Ernő Goldfinger’s Trellick Tower was completed in 1972 as a 31-storey council housing block. Its separate service tower, linked by bridges at every third floor, leaves flats free of lifts and ducts; bold bush-hammered concrete, generous maisonettes and a rooftop plant room define its uncompromising Brutalist silhouette.
places.descriptionIt: La Trellick Tower di Ernő Goldfinger fu completata nel 1972 come edificio di edilizia pubblica di 31 piani. La torre di servizio separata, collegata da ponti ogni tre piani, libera gli alloggi da ascensori e impianti; cemento martellinato, maisonette generose e locale tecnico in cima definiscono la silhouette brutalista.
places.accessNotes: The exterior is visible from the public realm. The building itself is not a general visitor attraction; respect private entrances, residents and on-site security.
places.accessNotesIt: L’esterno è visibile dallo spazio pubblico. L’edificio non è un’attrazione aperta in generale: rispetta ingressi privati, residenti e controlli di sicurezza.
places.hook: Goldfinger separated homes from services, giving Trellick its dramatic tower-and-bridge silhouette.
places.hookIt: Goldfinger separò abitazioni e servizi, dando a Trellick la sua spettacolare silhouette di torre e ponti.

places.name: Trinity House
places.description: Samuel Wyatt designed Trinity House, completed in 1796, for the corporation responsible for lighthouses and maritime safety. Its Portland-stone classical façade overlooks Trinity Square; reconstructed after wartime bombing, ceremonial rooms display navigational instruments, portraits and models linked to Britain’s seafaring history.
places.descriptionIt: Samuel Wyatt progettò Trinity House, completata nel 1796, per l’ente responsabile di fari e sicurezza marittima. La facciata classica in pietra di Portland guarda Trinity Square; ricostruite dopo i bombardamenti, le sale cerimoniali espongono strumenti nautici, ritratti e modelli legati alla storia marittima britannica.
places.accessNotes: This is primarily a working or private building and is best appreciated from the public realm. Interior access is limited to authorised visits or occasional open days.
places.accessNotesIt: È soprattutto un edificio operativo o privato, da osservare dallo spazio pubblico. Gli interni sono accessibili solo con autorizzazione o durante aperture occasionali.
places.hook: Wyatt’s Portland-stone headquarters gives Britain’s lighthouse authority a dignified face beside the Tower.
places.hookIt: La sede in pietra di Portland di Wyatt offre un volto solenne all’autorità britannica dei fari accanto alla Torre.

places.name: Turner's House (Sandycombe Lodge)
places.description: Painter J. M. W. Turner designed Sandycombe Lodge as his country retreat, completed in 1813 with advice from his friend Sir John Soane. The compact villa’s central top-lit stair, shallow arches and carefully framed rooms show an artist thinking architecturally; restoration has recovered its Regency proportions and finishes.
places.descriptionIt: Il pittore J. M. W. Turner progettò Sandycombe Lodge come rifugio di campagna, completato nel 1813 con consigli dell’amico Sir John Soane. La scala centrale illuminata dall’alto, gli archi bassi e le stanze inquadrate mostrano un artista che pensa da architetto; il restauro ha recuperato proporzioni e finiture Regency.

places.hook: Turner’s own compact villa reveals the painter experimenting with Soane-like light and space.
places.hookIt: La compatta villa di Turner mostra il pittore mentre sperimenta luce e spazio alla maniera di Soane.

places.name: Valentines Mansion & Gardens
places.description: Valentines Mansion was built around 1696 for Elizabeth Tillotson, widow of the Archbishop of Canterbury, and enlarged by later owners. Restored rooms range from a Georgian drawing room to a Victorian kitchen, while the surrounding park retains formal gardens, a canal, grottoes and historic trees.
places.descriptionIt: Valentines Mansion fu costruita intorno al 1696 per Elizabeth Tillotson, vedova dell’arcivescovo di Canterbury, e ampliata dai proprietari successivi. Le sale restaurate vanno dal salotto georgiano alla cucina vittoriana; il parco conserva giardini formali, canale, grotte e alberi storici.

places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso dipende da orari, programma e controlli del luogo. Controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire, soprattutto per interni o visite guidate.
places.hook: A late-seventeenth-century country house opens onto surviving formal gardens and waterways in Ilford.
places.hookIt: Una residenza di campagna del tardo Seicento si apre su giardini formali e corsi d’acqua superstiti a Ilford.

places.name: Vanbrugh Castle
places.description: Architect and dramatist Sir John Vanbrugh built Vanbrugh Castle around 1719 as his own home, shaping a compact house to resemble a medieval fortress. Round towers, battlements and massive walls give theatrical weight to a domestic plan; the Grade I building is now divided into private residences.
places.descriptionIt: L’architetto e drammaturgo Sir John Vanbrugh costruì Vanbrugh Castle intorno al 1719 come propria casa, dando a un edificio compatto l’aspetto di una fortezza medievale. Torri rotonde, merli e mura massicce conferiscono peso teatrale alla pianta domestica; l’edificio di grado I è oggi diviso in residenze private.
places.accessNotes: The exterior is visible from the public realm. The building itself is not a general visitor attraction; respect private entrances, residents and on-site security.
places.accessNotesIt: L’esterno è visibile dallo spazio pubblico. L’edificio non è un’attrazione aperta in generale: rispetta ingressi privati, residenti e controlli di sicurezza.

stations.name: Cutty Sark (for Maritime Greenwich) DLR Station

places.hook: Vanbrugh compressed his taste for heroic castle architecture into his own compact Greenwich home.
places.hookIt: Vanbrugh condensò il gusto per l’architettura eroica dei castelli nella propria casa compatta di Greenwich.

places.name: Wapping Hydraulic Power Station
places.description: Wapping Hydraulic Power Station was built in 1889–93 for the London Hydraulic Power Company. Steam-driven pumps pressurised a citywide network that silently operated dock gates, cranes, theatre curtains and lifts; the robust brick engine house survives as a rare monument to London’s lost hydraulic utility.
places.descriptionIt: La Wapping Hydraulic Power Station fu costruita nel 1889–93 per la London Hydraulic Power Company. Pompe a vapore pressurizzavano una rete urbana che azionava silenziosamente porte dei docks, gru, sipari e ascensori; la robusta sala macchine in mattoni è un raro monumento a questa rete scomparsa.
places.accessNotes: This is primarily a working or private building and is best appreciated from the public realm. Interior access is limited to authorised visits or occasional open days.
places.accessNotesIt: È soprattutto un edificio operativo o privato, da osservare dallo spazio pubblico. Gli interni sono accessibili solo con autorizzazione o durante aperture occasionali.
places.hook: A Victorian pumping station once powered lifts, cranes and theatre curtains through high-pressure water beneath London.
places.hookIt: Una centrale vittoriana azionava ascensori, gru e sipari con acqua ad alta pressione sotto Londra.

places.name: Warrington Hotel
places.description: The Warrington was built in the mid-nineteenth century and remodelled around 1900 into an unusually lavish Maida Vale pub. Glazed tiles, etched glass, carved wood, decorative plaster and a sweeping staircase preserve the confidence of the late-Victorian gin palace, with hotel rooms occupying the floors above.
places.descriptionIt: The Warrington fu costruito a metà Ottocento e rinnovato intorno al 1900 come pub insolitamente sontuoso di Maida Vale. Piastrelle smaltate, vetri incisi, legno intagliato, stucchi e una scala scenografica conservano l’opulenza del gin palace tardo-vittoriano, con camere d’albergo ai piani superiori.
places.accessNotes: Public access depends on the venue’s current opening hours, programme and security arrangements. Check the official site before travelling, especially for interiors or guided visits.
places.accessNotesIt: L’accesso dipende da orari, programma e controlli del luogo. Controlla il sito ufficiale prima di partire, soprattutto per interni o visite guidate.
places.hook: Etched glass, glazed tiles and carved wood preserve the theatrical interior of a Maida Vale gin palace.
places.hookIt: Vetri incisi, piastrelle smaltate e legno intagliato conservano l’interno teatrale di un gin palace di Maida Vale.

places.name: Wembley Stadium
places.description: The present Wembley Stadium opened in 2007, designed by Foster + Partners and Populous on the site of the 1923 Empire Stadium. Its 133-metre-high steel arch supports much of the retractable roof and replaces the old Twin Towers as the national stadium’s skyline marker; the bowl seats 90,000.
places.descriptionIt: L’attuale Wembley Stadium aprì nel 2007, progettato da Foster + Partners e Populous sul sito dell’Empire Stadium del 1923. L’arco d’acciaio alto 133 metri sostiene gran parte del tetto retrattile e sostituisce le vecchie Twin Towers come segno nello skyline; l’anello contiene 90.000 posti.
places.accessNotes: Admission, opening times and tour availability vary. Check the official site for current tickets, timed entry, event restrictions and closures before travelling.
places.accessNotesIt: Biglietti, orari e visite variano. Controlla il sito ufficiale per ingressi, prenotazioni, limitazioni durante gli eventi e chiusure prima di partire.
places.hook: A 133-metre arch carries the roof and announces Britain’s 90,000-seat national stadium across London.
places.hookIt: Un arco di 133 metri sostiene il tetto e segnala in tutta Londra lo stadio nazionale da 90.000 posti.

places.name: Westminster Hall
places.description: William II began Westminster Hall in 1097, making it the oldest surviving part of the Palace of Westminster. Richard II’s rebuilding of the 1390s added Hugh Herland’s immense hammer-beam timber roof; coronation banquets, state trials, lying-in-state ceremonies and parliamentary addresses have filled the hall for nine centuries.
places.descriptionIt: Guglielmo II iniziò Westminster Hall nel 1097, oggi la parte più antica superstite del Palace of Westminster. La ricostruzione di Riccardo II negli anni 1390 aggiunse l’immenso tetto ligneo a capriate di Hugh Herland; banchetti d’incoronazione, processi di Stato e cerimonie vi si sono svolti per nove secoli.

places.name: Wilton's Music Mall
places.description: Wilton’s combines five eighteenth-century houses with the music hall John Wilton built behind them in 1859. Once a sailors’ entertainment hall and later a mission, it survived dereliction with layers of paint, plaster and repair deliberately visible; careful conservation keeps that accumulated texture within a working theatre.

Prima sala per marinai e poi missione, sopravvisse all’abbandono con strati di pittura, intonaco e riparazioni volutamente visibili; il restauro conserva questa patina in un teatro ancora attivo.

places.name: Woolwich Town Hall
places.description: Woolwich Town Hall opened in 1906, designed by Alfred Brumwell Thomas as an emphatic expression of the new metropolitan borough. Its Edwardian Baroque exterior leads to a marble-lined entrance hall, stained glass celebrating local military and industrial history, and richly decorated civic rooms still used by Greenwich Council.

L’esterno barocco edoardiano introduce una hall rivestita di marmo, vetrate sulla storia militare e industriale locale e sale civiche ancora usate dal Greenwich Council.

places.name: Zoroastrian Centre
places.description: The Zoroastrian Centre occupies the former Grosvenor Cinema, opened in 1936 to a striking Art Deco design by F. E. Bromige. Its streamlined corner tower, stepped forms and richly modelled auditorium survived later bingo use; acquired by the Zoroastrian Trust Funds of Europe, it reopened as a religious and cultural centre in 2000.

Torre angolare aerodinamica, volumi a gradoni e auditorium decorato sopravvissero all’uso come bingo; acquistato dagli Zoroastrian Trust Funds of Europe, riaprì nel 2000 come centro religioso e culturale.

places.name: Alexander Fleming Museum
places.description: The Alexander Fleming Laboratory Museum reconstructs the small St Mary’s Hospital laboratory where Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928. Original equipment, photographs and explanatory displays show the accidental observation, later development of the drug and the transformation of modern infection treatment.

Attrezzature originali, fotografie e display esplicativi mostrano l'osservazione accidentale, in seguito lo sviluppo del farmaco e la trasformazione del trattamento delle infezioni moderne.

places.name: Amersham Museum
places.description: Amersham Museum occupies two connected buildings at 49 and 51 High Street in Old Amersham, including a fifteenth-century timber-framed house. Room settings, objects, photographs and oral histories follow the town from medieval market and coaching centre to the arrival of the Metropolitan Railway and twentieth-century growth. A rear garden planted with medicinal and culinary herbs extends the story of domestic life beyond the galleries.
places.descriptionIt: Amersham Museum occupa due edifici collegati ai numeri 49 e 51 di High Street, a Old Amersham, compresa una casa a graticcio del Quattrocento. Ambienti, oggetti, fotografie e testimonianze orali seguono la città dal mercato medievale e dalle diligenze fino all’arrivo della Metropolitan Railway e alla crescita novecentesca. Sul retro, un giardino di erbe medicinali e culinarie amplia il racconto della vita domestica.

places.name: Battle of Britain Bunker
places.description: Battle of Britain Bunker at RAF Uxbridge is a compact, atmospheric wartime operations room where No.11 Group coordinated fighter defences in 1940. Descend the steps to the restored underground Operations Room, see the giant plotting map, hear authentic soundscapes and wartime voices, and explore exhibitions on radar, pilots and Polish squadrons. Guided tours bring tense, human stories to life; book ahead for the full experience.

Visite guidate portano tensione, storie umane alla vita; prenoti per tutta l'esperienza.

places.name: Benjamin Franklin House
places.description: Benjamin Franklin House is a museum in a terraced Georgian house at 36 Craven Street, London, close to Trafalgar Square in the West End of London. It is the last-standing former residence of Benjamin Franklin, one of the Founding Fathers of the United States. The house dates from c. 1730, and Franklin lived and worked there from 1757 to 1774, when it was owned by Margaret Stevenson.

La casa risale a c. 1730, e Franklin visse e vi lavorò dal 1757 al 1774, quando era di proprietà di Margaret Stevenson.

places.description: Bletchley Park is an English country house and estate in Bletchley, Milton Keynes (Buckinghamshire), that became the principal centre of Allied code-breaking during the Second World War. During World War II, the estate housed the Government Code and Cypher School (GC&CS), which regularly penetrated the secret communications of the Axis powers – most importantly the German Enigma and Lorenz ciphers.

places.description: The Bow Street Museum of Crime and Justice is a museum of policing and criminal justice housed on the ground floor of the former police station on Bow Street in Covent Garden, London. It presents Bow Street's unique place in London's police history, alongside the story of policing and criminal justice in the area from the eighteenth century until the station's closure in 1992.

Archaeology, domestic objects, photographs and oral histories chart suburban growth, migration, work and entertainment, while temporary displays revisit local stories in greater detail.

places.description: The British Optical Association Museum preserves the history of spectacles, optometry and vision science. places.name: Bruce Castle Museum
places.description: Bruce Castle (formerly the Lordship House) is a Grade I listed 16th-century manor house in Lordship Lane, Tottenham, London. It is named after the House of Bruce who formerly owned the land on which it is built. Believed to stand on the site of an earlier building, about which little is known, the current house is one of the oldest surviving English brick houses.

Prende il nome dalla Casa di Bruce che precedentemente possedeva la terra su cui è costruita. Pensato per stare sul sito di un edificio precedente, su cui poco è noto, la casa attuale è una delle più antiche case di mattoni inglesi sopravvissuti.

places.description: The Brunel Museum is a small museum situated at the Brunel Engine House, Rotherhithe, London Borough of Southwark. The Engine House was designed by Sir Marc Isambard Brunel as part of the infrastructure of the Thames Tunnel which opened in 1843 and was the first underwater tunnel to have been built anywhere in the world.

La casa motore fu progettata da Sir Marc Isambard Brunel nell'ambito dell'infrastruttura del tunnel Thames che aprì nel 1843 e fu il primo tunnel subacqueo ad essere stato costruito in tutto il mondo.

places.name: Burgh House
places.description: Burgh House was built in 1704 during Hampstead’s growth as a fashionable spa and has served as a home, officers’ mess and community arts centre. Its panelled Queen Anne rooms now contain Hampstead Museum, whose displays cover local residents, artists and social history. Temporary exhibitions, recitals and talks continue the house’s cultural role, while the walled garden and basement café make its domestic scale easy to appreciate.

Le sale rivestite in legno dell’età della regina Anna ospitano oggi Hampstead Museum, dedicato agli abitanti, agli artisti e alla storia sociale del quartiere. Mostre temporanee, concerti e incontri proseguono il ruolo culturale della casa, insieme al giardino e al caffè.

places.description: Charlton House is a Jacobean mansion in Charlton, within the Royal Borough of Greenwich in south-east London. Built between 1607 and 1612, it is widely regarded as one of the finest and best-preserved examples of Jacobean domestic architecture in England, and the only complete Jacobean mansion surviving in Greater London following the destruction of Holland House during the Second World War.

places.description: Chisenhale Gallery is a non-profit contemporary art gallery based in London's East End. The gallery occupies the ground level of a former veneer factory on Chisenhale Road, situated in the London Borough of Tower Hamlets, near Victoria Park and flanking the Hertford Union Canal. places.description: The Churchill War Rooms is a museum in London and one of the five branches of the Imperial War Museum. The museum comprises the Cabinet War Rooms, a historic underground complex that housed a British government command centre throughout the Second World War, and the Churchill Museum, a biographical museum exploring the life of British statesman Winston Churchill.

Free interpretation, archaeological objects and reconstructions explain how the wall was built, repaired and absorbed into later structures, revealing nearly two millennia of change on one site.

places.name: Crofton Roman Villa
places.description: Crofton Roman Villa in Crofton, Orpington, in the London Borough of Bromley, is a Roman villa which was inhabited between approximately 140 and 400 AD. It was the centre of a farming estate of about 500 acres (200 ha), with farm buildings nearby, surrounded by fields, meadows and woods. The house was altered several times during its 260 years of occupation, and at its largest it probably had at least 20 rooms.

Era il centro di una tenuta agricola di circa 500 acri (200 ha), con edifici agricoli nelle vicinanze, circondati da campi, prati e boschi. La casa è stata modificata più volte durante i suoi 260 anni di occupazione, e al suo più grande probabilmente aveva almeno 20 camere.

places.description: Croydon Airport Visitor Centre occupies part of the world’s first purpose-built international airport terminal, opened in 1928. Displays and guided visits interpret early airlines, pioneering flights, customs and control-tower operations at the airport that served London before Heathrow took over its role.

places.name: Crystal Palace Museum
places.description: Crystal Palace Museum in Sydenham preserves the story of the great glass palace and its local legacy. Housed in a Victorian lecture hall, the compact museum displays photographs, models, artefacts and audio-visual exhibits that trace the building’s rise, relocation and dramatic demise. Friendly volunteers, school programmes and community events bring history to life; free entry and a small shop make it an easy, rewarding stop. Allow time to explore nearby parkland, cafés and Victorian terraces.
places.descriptionIt: Crystal Palace Museum di Sydenham conserva la storia del grande palazzo di vetro e della sua eredità locale. Ospitato in una sala conferenze vittoriana, il museo compatto mostra fotografie, modelli, artefatti e mostre audiovisive che tracciano l'ascesa dell'edificio, il trasferimento e la drammatica scomparsa. I volontari amichevoli, i programmi scolastici e gli eventi comunitari portano alla vita la storia; l'ingresso gratuito e un piccolo negozio lo rendono una sosta facile e gratificante. Permettete il tempo di esplorare vicino parco, caffè e terrazze vittoriane.

places.name: Dulwich Picture Gallery
places.description: Dulwich Picture Gallery is an art gallery in Dulwich, south London, and the oldest public art gallery in England. Opened in 1817 to a design by Regency architect Sir John Soane, it became a landmark in museum architecture through its innovative use of natural light. Originally part of the College of God's Gift, the charitable foundation established by Edward Alleyn in the early 17th century, the gallery became an independent charitable trust in 1994.

Inaugurato nel 1817 ad un progetto dell'architetto Regency Sir John Soane, divenne un punto di riferimento nell'architettura museale attraverso il suo uso innovativo della luce naturale. Originariamente parte del College of God's Gift, la fondazione caritativa fondata da Edward Alleyn all'inizio del XVII secolo, la galleria divenne una fiducia caritativa indipendente nel 1994.

Guided tours, family trails and a café make it ideal for history and design lovers

It is the country's only gallery devoted to modern Italian art and is a registered charity. The Estorick Collection was founded by the American sociologist and writer Eric Estorick (1913–1993), who began to collect art when he moved to England after the Second World War.

La Collezione Estorick fu fondata dal sociologo e scrittore statunitense Eric Estorick (1913-1993), che iniziò a raccogliere l'arte quando si trasferì in Inghilterra dopo la seconda guerra mondiale.

places.description: Florence Nightingale Museum at St Thomas’ Hospital celebrates the life and legacy of the pioneering nurse. Intimate galleries display personal letters, lamps, uniforms and interactive exhibits that trace nursing, public health and wartime care. Guided talks, family activities and a shop complement visits. A thoughtful, inspiring stop near the Thames for anyone curious about medical history and social reform.

Visite guidate ai colloqui, alle attività familiari e ai complementi di negozio. places.name: Grant Museum of Zoology
places.description: The Grant Museum of Zoology and Comparative Anatomy is a natural history museum that is part of University College London in London, England. It was established by Robert Edmond Grant in 1828 as a teaching collection of zoological specimens and material for dissection. It is one of the oldest natural history collections in the UK, and is the last remaining university natural history museum in London.

È una delle più antiche collezioni di storia naturale del Regno Unito, ed è l'ultimo museo di storia naturale dell'università a Londra.

places.description: Headstone Manor and Museum occupies a rare moated medieval manor complex and tells the history of Harrow. Galleries across restored farm buildings use archaeology, maps, photographs and everyday objects to explain the area’s rural estates, suburban expansion and changing communities.

places.name: Heath Robinson Museum
places.description: Heath Robinson Museum in Pinner celebrates the witty, inventive work of illustrator William Heath Robinson. Set in Memorial Park, the compact museum displays original drawings, books and models of his famously over‑engineered contraptions. Rotating exhibitions, family activities and hands‑on displays delight children and adults alike. Friendly volunteers, a small shop and park cafés make it a charming, accessible stop for a relaxed visit.

Situato nel Memorial Park, il museo compatto presenta disegni, libri e modelli originali delle sue famose contrapzioni sovra-progettate. Esposizioni in rotazione, attività familiari e esposizioni pratiche deliziano bambini e adulti allo stesso modo. I volontari amichevoli, un piccolo negozio e i caffè del parco lo rendono una fermata affascinante e accessibile per una visita rilassata.

places.name: Hogarth's House
places.description: Hogarth's House is the former country home of the 18th-century English artist William Hogarth in Chiswick, adjacent to the A4. The House now belongs to the London Borough of Hounslow and is open to visitors as a historic house museum free of charge. Chiswick is now one of London's western suburbs, but in the 18th century it was a large village or small town quite separate from the metropolis, but within easy reach of it.
places.descriptionIt: Hogarth's House è l'ex patria dell'artista inglese del XVIII secolo William Hogarth a Chiswick, adiacente all'A4. La Casa appartiene ora al London Borough di Hounslow ed è aperta ai visitatori come museo di casa storica gratuitamente. Chiswick è ora una delle periferie occidentali di Londra, ma nel XVIII secolo era un grande villaggio o piccola città abbastanza separata dalla metropoli, ma a breve distanza.

places.name: Home of Charles Darwin
places.description: Down House, Charles Darwin’s family home in Downe (Bromley), offers a warm, intimate glimpse into the life of the scientist who changed how we see nature. Explore Darwin’s study preserved as he left it, wander the experimental gardens and glasshouses where he tested ideas, and follow family rooms, exhibitions and trails that bring evolution to life. Guided tours, a café and shop make it a relaxed, inspiring day out for curious visitors.
places.descriptionIt: Down House, casa di famiglia di Charles Darwin a Downe (Bromley), offre uno sguardo caldo e intimo nella vita dello scienziato che ha cambiato come vediamo la natura. Esplora lo studio di Darwin conservato mentre lo lasciava, vagare per i giardini sperimentali e le vetrerie dove ha testato idee, e seguire sale familiari, mostre e percorsi che portano l'evoluzione alla vita. Visite guidate, un caffè e un negozio lo rendono una giornata rilassata e stimolante per i visitatori curiosi.

places.description: Honeywood is a Grade II-listed house beside Carshalton Ponds that developed from a seventeenth-century core. Period rooms and local-history displays explore the building, the River Wandle, childhood and domestic life, while windows and garden views connect the museum to Carshalton’s historic village landscape.

places.description: The House of Dreams Museum is a terraced house in East Dulwich, England, transformed into the personal art museum of former textile designer and art director Stephen Wright. Wright worked on the museum in secret until the 2010s, when he began to open it to the public several days each year. It is now open to the public ten times a year usually on the last Saturday of the month.

Historic interiors, ship models, paintings and maritime objects interpret the vessel’s wartime service and Britain’s merchant-maritime traditions; public access is event-dependent.

places.name: Hunterian Museum
places.description: London’s Hunterian Museum is inside the Royal College of Surgeons of England in Lincoln’s Inn Fields. At its heart is the collection of eighteenth-century surgeon-anatomist John Hunter, expanded with anatomical and pathological specimens, surgical instruments, models and works of art. The galleries trace the science, craft and ethics of surgery from ancient practice to modern operating theatres, explaining how observation and collecting changed medical knowledge.
